personnages.premier_jeu: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty
personnages.description: Dr. Hal "Otacon" Emmerich was the chief engineer of Metal Gear REX. He became a close friend of Solid Snake after Snake rescued him during the Shadow Moses Incident in 2005. Later that year, he and Snake founded the anti-Metal Gear NGO Philanthropy. Following the Guns of the Patriots Incident, he became the adoptive father of Sunny. A devoted fan of anime, Hal's chosen nickname was derived from "Otaku Convention", which he directly mentions to Snake during an in game conversation (this has no relationship to the American anime convention known as "Otakon" which has a different spelling and pronunciation; Kojima himself has never referenced this DC convention as an inspiration).
personnages.premiere: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (2001)
personnages.jeux_phares: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (2001) · Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots (2008)

personnages.premier_jeu: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty
personnages.description: Vamp was an ex-member of Dead Cell with vampire-like attributes, including a taste for blood, the ability to run across or stand on the surface of water or vertical walls, superhuman speed and agility, and the ability to shrug off and rapidly heal from the most extreme and fatal wounds. Besides his seemingly superhuman abilities, he was also an expert with knives and close quarters combat.
personnages.premiere: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (2001)
personnages.jeux_phares: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (2001) · Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots (2008)

personnages.description: President John Henry Eden is an advanced ZAX AI unit installed in the Raven Rock military complex northwest of Washington, D.C.. Using a crafted presidential persona, it proclaimed itself to be the next president of the Enclave after the fall of Control Station ENCLAVE circa 2241, becoming the organization's public face to the inhabitants of the Capital Wasteland by 2277. It serves as one of the two primary antagonists alongside Augustus Autumn.

Hannibal Hamlin is a former slave residing in the Temple of the Union in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. As the founder and leader of the Abolitionists, a militant anti-slavery organization, he has committed them to freeing all slaves and defeating the institution of slavery at Paradise Falls.
Sergeant RL-3, also truncated to simply Sarge, is a robot who can be bought from Tinker Joe in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. He is a possible companion of the Lone Wanderer.
Elder Owyn Lyons is the leader of the East Coast Brotherhood of Steel in 2277.
Grouse is a slaver at Paradise Falls in 2277.

Three Dog is the radio host, DJ, and news anchor for Galaxy News Radio, operating from the old GNR station within the ruins of Washington, D.C. in 2277. With the protection of Lyons' Brotherhood of Steel, Three Dog keeps his listeners up to date on current events in the Capital Wasteland with his color commentary and entertained with music tracks.
Abraham Washington is the owner and curator of the Capitol Preservation Society in Rivet City in 2277.
Tree Father Birch is the leader of the Treeminders in Oasis .
Reilly is a member as well as the leader and founder of the mercenary band known as Reilly's Rangers encountered in the Capital Wasteland .
Star Paladin Cross is an officer of the Capital Wasteland chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel residing in the Citadel in 2277. She is a possible companion of the Lone Wanderer.

Colonel Augustus Autumn is the commanding officer of the Department of the Army for John Henry Eden's division of the Enclave occupying the Capital Wasteland in 2277. He serves as one of the two primary antagonists of alongside John Henry Eden.

Confessor Cromwell is a member of the Church of the Children of Atom residing in Megaton in the Capital Wasteland , where he leads the Children in the worship of the undetonated atomic bomb that gave Megaton its name.
Reginald Rothchild is the senior scribe of the Brotherhood of Steel in 2277.
Lucy West is a resident of Megaton in 2277.
Clover is a slave residing with her owner Eulogy Jones at the slaver stronghold of Paradise Falls in 2277. She is a possible companion of the Lone Wanderer.

Sierra Petrovita is a Nuka-Cola fanatic and collector residing in the small settlement of Girdershade in the Capital Wasteland with her neighbor and protector Ronald Laren in 2277. By 2287, the older Sierra has taken a trip to the Nuka-World amusement park near the Commonwealth, looking to complete an ancient scavenger hunt.
Mister Burke is an associate of Allistair Tenpenny operating in Megaton in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

Fawkes is a super mutant residing in a cell within Vault 87 in the Capital Wasteland in 2277, imprisoned there by his brethren for his peaceful nature and interest in learning history instead of killing humans. He is a possible companion of the Lone Wanderer.
Edwin Brotch is a resident of Vault 101 and the vault's teacher in 2277.
Eulogy Jones is the head slaver of Paradise Falls in 2277.
Harden Simms is an inhabitant of Megaton in 2277.

Sentinel Sarah Lyons is the highest ranking Brotherhood of Steel officer at the Citadel after Elder Owyn Lyons, her father, and the commander of the elite squad Lyons' Pride . After her father's death, Sarah replaced him as elder, and remained in that position until she was killed in action, paving the way for Arthur Maxson's rise, and his eventual appointment as elder . She is also a legendary dweller in Fallout Shelter and an SSR Vault Dweller in Fallout Shelter Online.

Doctor Madison Li is the lead scientist and council representative for the science lab of Rivet City in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. By 2287, she had travelled to the Commonwealth, where she resides in the Institute's underground facility and serves as the incumbent head of the Advanced Systems division (Institute username Li.M).
Timmy Neusbaum is one of the residents of Vault 112, trapped within the Tranquility Lane simulation .
Chief Gustavo is the security chief of Tenpenny Tower in 2277.

Paladin Vargas is a Brotherhood of Steel soldier and sergeant of the elite Lyons' Pride squad . He is initially encountered patrolling the lobby of the Galaxy News Radio building. After completing the Following in His Footsteps quest, he can be seen patrolling the Citadel. When traveling across the bridge during the quest Take it Back!, Vargas could be killed. If he does survive, he will disappear from the game.
Colin Moriarty is a resident of Megaton and the owner of Moriarty's Saloon in 2277.
Dr. Weston Lesko is a scientist living in Grayditch, found inside Marigold station in 2277. He is indirectly responsible for causing the destruction of Grayditch.
Mister Buckingham is a Mister Handy robot in Rivet City in 2277.
Lucy "Old Lady" Palmer is a resident of Vault 101 in 2277.
Margaret Primrose runs the Café Beau Monde in Tenpenny Tower .

Robert Joseph "RJ" MacCready is the adolescent mayor of the child-exclusive settlement of Little Lamplight in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. By 2287, the grown-up MacCready has travelled to the Commonwealth, where he works as a mercenary, selling his services from the backroom of the Third Rail in Goodneighbor. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.
Paladin Gunny is a Brotherhood of Steel paladin stationed at the Citadel in 2277, and is tasked as the drill instructor for new initiates.

Allistair Tenpenny is the founder and owner of Tenpenny Tower, appearing . He is one of only nine named characters in the base game to have "Very Evil" Karma. He is also a Legendary dweller , coming with a unique rifle and suit.
Lucas Simms is the sheriff and de facto mayor of Megaton in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

personnages.premier_jeu: Leisure Suit Larry 6: Shape Up or Slip Out!
personnages.description: Mark refers to characters or cast and crew members named "Mark" or "Marc" throughout The Walking Dead franchise.
personnages.premiere: Leisure Suit Larry 6: Shape Up or Slip Out! (1993)
personnages.jeux_phares: The Walking Dead (2012) · Leisure Suit Larry 6: Shape Up or Slip Out! (1993)

personnages.description: Nyx, sometimes referred to as "Mother Night", is the personification of night and a resident in the House of Hades. She gives counsel, directions and reviews the day's work of Chthonic Gods and staff, as seen in her interactions with Megaera, Dusa and the House Contractor. She is also the creator of the Nocturnal Arms alongside her daughters The Fates. Nyx is a daughter of Chaos, and mother of The Fates, Charon, Geras, Philotes, Moros, Nemesis, Momus, Oizys, Thanatos, Hypnos, Eris, The Keres and many others, and foster mother of Selene and Zagreus. Nyx eventually curried favor with the Olympian Gods and gave Zagreus the Mirror of Night to aid in his escape.

Achilles is a demi-god hero famed for his role in the Trojan War as both a peerless warrior and as the leader of his tribe, the Myrmidons. He was dipped in the Styx by his mother as a child to grant him immortality but was left vulnerable on the heel by which Thetis held him. After he was fatally wounded when Paris shot his heel with an arrow, he descended to the Underworld as a Shade, where he was eventually hired by Hades to train a young Zagreus in battle and military discipline in exchange for allowing his lover Patroclus into Elysium. Since he was hired, Achilles has made an effort to be a source of support and encouragement for Zagreus in the face of Hades' often harsh treatment. Achilles is responsible for authoring all entries in the Codex, which he gives to Zagreus to provide information and guidance about the Underworld and the Olympian Gods, as well as the many foes, fish, and items he may come across.

Asterius, also known as the Minotaur, is a bull-headed demi-human who was recruited by Hades to help prevent Zagreus's escape. In life, Asterius was locked in a labyrinth by his step-father, King Minos, only to eventually be slain by Theseus. In death, the two are apparently comrades. Asterius is a potential mid-boss encounter in Elysium, as well as always appearing as the final boss of Elysium, alongside King Theseus in the Elysium Stadium.

Zagreus is the Crown-Prince of the Underworld and the rebellious son of Hades. He is the older brother of Melinoë and is the protagonist of Hades. He always had a sense that he doesn't belong in the House of Hades. After finding out the truth about his lineage, he decides to escape the underworld no matter what, going against his father's will. He is aided and encouraged in his journey by his mentor Achilles and his foster mother Nyx, who puts him into contact with the Olympian Gods who grant him boons to make him more powerful during his escape attempts. Despite aiding him, they continued to patronize him by treating him as a young godling. In his escape attempts, Zagreus will start at Tartarus, continue upwards and end his journey at the surface, where he cannot stay for long and must return back down along the river. Along the way, he may meet Sisyphus and other friendly faces who will help him, as well as Charon the shopkeeper who sells his various powerful wares. Zagreus is met with many obstacles in his journey upwards such as aggressive shades working for his father and has run-ins with the guardians of each region like the Furies, Bone Hydra, and the champions of Elysium Theseus and Asterius - culminating in a fight against his father, Lord Hades. Losing all of his health at any point results in an express trip back home. In Hades II, Zagreus is captured by Chronos along with all the members of the House of Hades. His rescue and that of his family is one of the main g

Skelly is a Bloodless "employed" by the House of Hades as a training dummy. While Skelly claims to be on the House's payroll, he refuses to reveal who hired him and is similarly unwilling to discuss his past, instead preferring to play various pranks on Zagreus. Oddly, no one in the House seems to be aware of his existence besides Zagreus and Achilles, unless the former asks them about him. Skelly has 900 HP. As he's already dead, he will simply reform after being "killed" in training. He seems suspiciously enthusiastic about getting beaten up. Skelly returns in Hades II as Commander Schelemeus, who aids Melinoë in her fight against Chronos. His role is similar to the first game, where he can be used as a training dummy and offer advice on the various game mechanics.

Megaera is one of the three sisters Furies. She is the older sister of Tisiphone and Alecto, being responsible for punishing adulterers, oathbreakers, and thieves. She is sent by Hades to stop Zagreus from escaping the Underworld. Zagreus must defeat her before progressing to Asphodel during any given escape attempt. After her first defeat, Megaera will join the House of Hades as a character that can be interacted with, though she will still attempt to stop Zagreus from entering Asphodel. She will be found drinking in the House's lounge, but only after a run in which she was defeated; if the lounge has yet to be re-opened, she will instead hang around in the hallway, on the opposite side of Zagreus's door from where Nyx usually stands. Apparently, she has been tasked with handling matters in Tartarus apart from her sisters; this includes dealing with Zagreus. According to Megaera, a war amongst the mortals has made the Underworld particularly busy, and her sisters are handling matters elsewhere.

Dusa is a Shade in the form of a floating, disembodied Gorgon's head. She works as a maid in the House of Hades under Nyx, constantly floating around and cleaning, and after a time is promoted to the House's Head Custodian.

Eurydice is a deceased oak nymph and the former wife of the musician Orpheus. Despite having some qualities of other gods and immortals, she died from a snake bite and was ferried to Underworld. A grieving Orpheus ventured to the Underworld to plea for her return. He charmed Lord Hades with his music and was given leave to bring Eurydice with him back to the surface, on the condition that he not look back at her until he left the Underworld. Ultimately he succumbed to his own insecurities, and Eurydice was forced to remain in the land of the dead. Eurydice now resides in her own private corner of Asphodel, where she spends eternity singing and cooking with the help of the river Phlegethon's heat. Her former husband still seems to be a bit of a sore subject for her. The two are apparently kept apart by an official separation order issued from Hades' desk, likely as a condition of the deal that allowed Orpheus to attempt to rescue her. If interacted with, she will offer Zagreus a selection of Underworld delicacies designed to boost his Boons.

Orpheus is a legendary musician. During his life, he lost his wife and muse Eurydice and ventured to the Underworld to plea for her return. Although he was ultimately unable to bring her back to life, he charmed Hades with his music such that after his death, Hades employed Orpheus as his court musician. However, because he has lost his muse, he is unable to bring himself to sing, though he may be persuaded otherwise.

Hypnos is the embodiment of sleep. He is one of Nyx's many children, and the younger twin brother of Thanatos. He watches over the procession of newly-arrived shades coming before Hades, checking their names off his list. He is often seen sleeping on the job. He greets Zagreus most of the time when the prince is killed and returns to the House via the Pool of Styx, and often gives unhelpful advice and a quip about whichever enemy or natural force did Zagreus in. Hypnos returns in Hades II, but in a state of deep coma induced by sleep. One of Melinoë's missions is to wake him up.

Lucrezia Borgia (Valencian: Lucrècia Borja; 1480 – 1519) was the illegitimate daughter of Rodrigo Borgia, and the younger sister of Cesare Borgia. Like her father and brother, she was a member of the Templar Order, and later became the Duchess-consort of Ferrara. During her lifetime, Lucrezia was ruthlessly betrothed by her father twice before her thirteenth birthday in order to secure political alliances. She was also rumored to have been sexually abused by her father and brothers. Lucrezia later assisted Rodrigo and Cesare in their attempt to keep Rome under their control, mainly by monitoring the events that took place when her father and brother were away or unavailable. She was also responsible for guarding Caterina Sforza, the Countess of Forlì, when she was imprisoned in the Castel Sant'Angelo.

Juan Borgia the Elder (1446 – 1503) was one of Cesare Borgia's three generals, who ruled over Rome during the reign of Pope Alexander VI. He was the first Cardinal-nephew appointed by Alexander, and also a member of the Roman Rite of the Templar Order. Often referred to as "the Banker," he handled Cesare's military funds and aided the Borgia's campaigns to subdue Italy for the Templars. However, he also spent a considerable amount of money throwing lavish, and often sexually-oriented, public parties.

Cesare Borgia (Valencian: Cèsar Borja; Spanish: César Borja; 1475 – 1507) was an Italian condottiero and nobleman, the illegitimate son of Rodrigo Borgia, and a nemesis of the Assassin Ezio Auditore da Firenze. Like his father, he was also a member of the Roman Rite of the Templar Order, serving as its de facto leader from 1500 to 1503 before assuming the title of Grand Master upon Rodrigo's death. Originally a Cardinal, Cesare harbored ambitions to become of the Papal armies, which he eventually accomplished after having his older brother Juan killed in 1497. He spent the next few years consolidating his power and surrounding himself with equally cruel and effective men, most of whom he had killed as well, to prevent them from turning against him. After learning about the Apple of Eden held by the Assassins, Cesare led a siege of their stronghold in Monteriggioni, successfully seizing the Apple and leaving the Italian Brotherhood in disarray. He then began a campaign to conquer all of Italy, allegedly to unite it under the Templar banner. In reality, despite his loyalty to the Templars, they were a secondary concern compared to Cesare's desire to increase his own power. Because Cesare was preoccupied with his conquests, he failed to prevent the Assassins from rebuilding their strength in Rome, resulting in Cesare losing all of his funding and military support. When he returned to the city and demanded the Apple of Eden from his father, Rodrigo refused to give it to him, lead

Nick Valentine is a synth residing in Diamond City in the Commonwealth in 2287, solving cases as the owner and sole detective of Valentine Detective Agency. He appears as a possible companion of the Sole Survivor and is expanded upon in the Far Harbor add-on.

Mister Handy (stylized as Mr. Handy) is a multipurpose robot developed by General Atomics International before the Great War and refined in collaboration with RobCo Industries. It was an incredibly popular model, used by government agencies, private companies and individual citizens across the United States.

Piper Wright is a resident of Diamond City in the Commonwealth in 2287, delivering the news of current events as the owner, publisher, and sole journalist of the Publick Occurrences newspaper. She is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

Paladin Danse (registration DN-407P) is a member of the East Coast division of the Brotherhood of Steel, serving as the commanding officer of Recon Squad Gladius in the Commonwealth in 2287. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

Preston Garvey is a member and officer of the Commonwealth Minutemen operating in the Commonwealth in 2287, defending refugees under his protection from an attack by raiders in Concord. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

Desdemona, also known by her nickname Dez, is the leader of the secretive underground movement known as the Railroad in the Commonwealth in 2287. Believing synths to be sentient beings who deserve freedom and respect, the Railroad's mission is to help them flee the Institute, as well as protect them from the Brotherhood of Steel.
Mrs. Whitfield is a pre-War resident of Sanctuary Hills in 2077.

The Mistress of Mystery (Claudia Martin) is a fictional character created by Hubris Comics who appears in Fallout 4 and Fallout 76. Within the series fiction, she is portrayed by Shannon Rivers (voicework), who was planned to be replaced by Claire Redelle for the 2077 television series.

Deacon is a member of the Railroad and master of disguise, acting as a spy while performing field reconnaissance for their war against the Institute in the Commonwealth in 2287. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.
John Hancock is a ghoul residing in the Commonwealth in 2287, where he leads the independent drifter community of Goodneighbor as its mayor. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.
Cait is a cage fighter working at the Combat Zone in the Commonwealth in 2287. She is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

Robert Joseph "RJ" MacCready is the adolescent mayor of the child-exclusive settlement of Little Lamplight in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. By 2287, the grown-up MacCready has travelled to the Commonwealth, where he works as a mercenary, selling his services from the backroom of the Third Rail in Goodneighbor. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

The Contagions Vulnerability Robotic Infirmary Engineer (CVRIE), typically shortened to Curie, is a robot residing within a secret wing of Vault 81 in the Commonwealth. By 2287, she is the sole working physician in the secret wing, trying to develop a universal cure long after her human colleagues have died. She is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

X6-88 is a Generation 3 synth and member of the Coursers in service to the Institute in 2287, operating in the Commonwealth to hunt down other synths trying to escape their creators. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

Strong is an Institute super mutant residing in Trinity Tower in the Commonwealth in 2287, thrown in a cell with wasteland poet Rex Goodman because he wants to obtain the power of the "milk of human kindness" from humans. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.
Travis Miles is a resident of Diamond City in the Commonwealth in 2287, acting as the radio host and DJ for Diamond City Radio.
Lieutenant Colonel Smith is a character vocalized by the Tour bot near Swan's Pond .

Elder Arthur Maxson (registration MX-001E) is a prominent member of the Brotherhood of Steel in being the furthest known descendant of the bloodline of Roger Maxson, the Brotherhood's founder. Raised among the ranks of the Capital Wasteland chapter and serving as a squire in 2277, the subsequent decade saw the young Maxson rise to the position of elder in the reformed East Coast division of the Brotherhood, later leading as its supreme commander on an expedition to oppose the Institute in the War of the Commonwealth in 2287. Arthur Maxson appears as a child squire residing in the Citadel and then as an adult and the elder in charge of the Brotherhood onboard the command deck of the Prydwen .
Z2-47 is a synth courser working for the Institute in 2287.

Proctor Ingram (registration IG-444PR) is an officer of the East Coast Brotherhood of Steel in 2287. She serves as head of engineering aboard the Prydwen, responsible for the maintenance of the airship as well as other high-level projects for Elder Maxson in the expedition to the Commonwealth.

Lancer Captain Kells, registration KS-390LC, is the captain of the Brotherhood of Steel's airship the Prydwen in 2287. He is second-in-command of the Brotherhood's operations in the Commonwealth, reporting directly to Elder Maxson.
Jack Cabot is a physician, scientist, and member of the Cabot family residing at Cabot House in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Doc Weathers is a caravan merchant wandering in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Honest Dan is a mercenary hired by Old Man Stockton to investigate the disappearance of a caravan and his daughter near the settlement of Covenant .
Scribe Haylen, registration HN-118FS, is a field scribe of the Brotherhood of Steel, stationed at the Cambridge Police Station in 2287.
Ellie Perkins is the secretary of private investigator Nick Valentine, operating out of the Valentine Detective Agency located in Diamond City in 2287.

Doctor Madison Li is the lead scientist and council representative for the science lab of Rivet City in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. By 2287, she had travelled to the Commonwealth, where she resides in the Institute's underground facility and serves as the incumbent head of the Advanced Systems division (Institute username Li.M).
Dr. Brian Virgil (Institute username Virgil.B) is a super mutant living in the Commonwealth in 2287. He can be found in the rocky cave and he helps the Sole Survivor find a way into the Institute.
Thomas Weatherby, colloquially known as Tinker Tom (or TT in code), is the quartermaster and primary repairman for the Railroad, operating in the Commonwealth in 2287.

Proctor Quinlan, registration QN-448PR, is an officer of the East Coast Brotherhood of Steel in 2287, heading the department responsible for data recovery, archival, and research operations in the expedition to the Commonwealth. He appears .
Supervisor Brown is a Mister Handy operating at Graygarden in 2287

Sturges is a handyman and former resident of Quincy in the Commonwealth before being forced to flee with Preston Garvey's Minutemen group after the town was destroyed by the Gunners during the Quincy Massacre in 2287, becoming one of the few surviving group members by the time they were forced to shelter from a raider attack in the Museum of Freedom at Concord. He appears .

{{Quotation|{{tooltip|I got two words on what I expect out of you: best behavior.|{Matter of fact. Security guard. / Confident} }}|sound=Scott Edwards 001A5D94_1.ogg}} Scott Edwards is a security officer for Vault 81 in 2287.

Henry Cooke is the owner and barkeeper of the Colonial Taphouse and an Institute SRB informant for fugitive synths, living in his house in Diamond City's upper stands in 2287. Often going by his last name, Cooke is also an associate of chem trafficker Marowski. He can initially be found inside the Colonial Taphouse.
Bert Strickland (username BStrickland) was the mayor of University Point in 2285.

Knight L. Rhys, registration RS-104K, is a soldier of the Commonwealth chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel, serving under Paladin Danse as part of Recon Squad Gladius in the Commonwealth in 2287. He appears .

Paul Pembroke is a resident of Diamond City in 2287. He is the husband of Darcy Pembroke and the father of Pete Pembroke. He can initially be found inside the Colonial Taphouse, confronting Henry Cooke.
Neil Freund is a man living in Vault 81 in 2287.
Bobbi No-Nose is a resident of Goodneighbor and member of the Triggermen, occupying a backalley hideout to conduct her secret project in 2287.
Maria "Mary" Summerset is a resident of Vault 81 in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Doctor Amari is a scientist working with Irma in Goodneighbor's Memory Den in 2287.
Tommy Lonegan is the proprietor of the Combat Zone arena, living in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Doctor Stanley Carrington is the medic and the second-in-command of the Railroad in 2287.
Edward Deegan is a ghoul and an associate of the Cabot family in 2287. He has been in the employ of the family since before the Great War.
AJ is a chem dealer operating in Goodneighbor in 2287.
The P.A.M. (Predictive Analytic Machine) is a sophisticated AI tied to a modified Assaultron unit, currently installed at the Railroad HQ in 2287.

{{Quotation|{{tooltip|I realize it's not the most glamorous of missions, but hell, neither is starving.|{Amused} }}|sound=Teagan 0004498E 1.ogg}} Proctor Teagan, registration TG-477PR, is an officer of the East Coast Brotherhood of Steel in 2287, acting as the quartermaster aboard the Prydwen during the expedition to the Commonwealth. He appears .
Dr. Justin Ayo (username Ayo.J) is the acting director of the Synth Retention Bureau in 2287.

Mama Murphy is a chem-addicted fortune teller who allegedly wields a precognitive power called "the Sight". Formerly residing in the town of Quincy in the Commonwealth until it was attacked by the Gunners during the Quincy Massacre, Murphy escaped along with Preston Garvey and her fellow settlers and eventually sheltered in the Museum of Freedom within Concord. She appears .

Allie Filmore (username Filmore.A) is the chief engineer for the Institute in 2287. She is the head of the facilities division and one of the key characters in the Institute quest line. She is also a possible temporary companion.
Initiate D. Clarke (registration CL-312I) is a soldier of the Brotherhood of Steel, serving as a member of the logistics division under Knight Sergeant Gavil at Boston Airport in the Commonwealth .

Conrad Kellogg is a ruthless, highly skilled, and cybernetically-enhanced mercenary acting as the main surface operative for the Institute in the Commonwealth in 2287. He serves as the secondary antagonist .

Liam Binet (username Binet.L) is a scientist residing in the Institute in 2287. Unbeknownst to his colleagues, Liam has been covertly freeing their synth creations and sending them out into the Commonwealth where they are rescued by the Railroad. In this capacity, the synth liberators have codenamed him Patriot as an indirect asset to their cause.
Kent Connolly is a ghoulified radio operator and super fan of The Silver Shroud living in the Memory Den in Goodneighbor in 2287.
Edward L. "Eddie" Winter is a pre-War mob boss turned ghoul living in a hidden shelter in Boston in 2287.

{{Quotation|{{tooltip|Ah, the detective is back! You should have a drink, gumshoe!|{player discovered Doc Crocker killed Earl Sterling, your friend} }}|sound=Vadim Bobrov 000ECDC3_1.ogg|Vadim Bobrov to Nick Valentine}} Vadim Bobrov is the bartender and co-owner of the Dugout Inn, living in Diamond City in 2287.
Yefim Bobrov is the innkeeper and co-owner of the Dugout Inn, living in Diamond City in 2287.
Gwen McNamara is the incumbent overseer of Vault 81 in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Becky Fallon is a clothing merchant who runs Fallon's Basement in the Diamond City market in 2287.
Jun Long is a settler traveling with Preston Garvey and his group in the Commonwealth in 2287.

Doctor Sun is a doctor and facial reconstruction surgeon who resides in Diamond City in the year 2287. Before the completion of The Disappearing Act, Doctor Sun can be found in the Diamond City market.
Austin Engill is a child resident of Vault 81 in 2287.

Chris Rosa is one of Nate and Nora's neighbors in Sanctuary Hills in 2077. By 2287, he has become a feral ghoul roaming the Commonwealth. He is encountered as part of a random encounter, being one of a group of hostile ghouls.
{{Quotation|{{tooltip|You shoot people, mister? My dad says outsiders shoot people.|{fearless child} }}|sound=Pete Pembroke 00047E71_1.ogg}} Pete Pembroke is a child living in Diamond City in 2287.
Robert "Bobby" De Luca is a resident of Vault 81 in 2287.
Alan Binet (username Binet.A) is the head of the Institute's Robotics division in 2287.
Mandy Stiles is a scavenger in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Alexis Combes is a woman living in Vault 81 in 2287.
Darcy Pembroke is a resident of Diamond City in 2287. She is the wife of Paul Pembroke and the mother of Pete Pembroke. She can first be found drinking inside the Colonial Taphouse.
Ann Codman is a snobby, rude woman living in the upper stands of Diamond City in 2287.
Wilhelmina Cabot is the matriarch of the Cabot family living in the Cabot House in Boston in 2287.
Max Loken (username Loken.M) is a scientist in the Institute in 2287.
Malcom Latimer is a wealthy resident of Diamond City and an associate of the Triggermen in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Paladin Brandis is a paladin of the Brotherhood of Steel stranded in the Commonwealth in 2287.
Arlen Glass is a ghoul living in The Slog in 2287.
McDonough is a resident of Diamond City in the Commonwealth in 2287, serving as its incumbent mayor since being elected in 2282.
Moe Cronin is a merchant who resides in Diamond City in 2287. He runs Swatters, a custom baseball bat store in the Diamond City market.

In Fallout 4, the Sole Survivor can build and manage their own settlements at various sites around the Commonwealth. The workshop interface is used to place and connect pre-fabricated structures as well as individual pieces (walls, floors, roofs, etc.) letting the player character construct their own home base(s) as they desire.
The Silver Shroud is a side quest .
Doctor Clayton Holdren (username Holdren.C) is a member of the Institute. He is the director of Institute BioScience in 2287.

Captain Zao is the ghoulified captain of the Yangtze-31 and a former officer of the pre-War Chinese Navy. By 2287, he has been left isolated on board his disabled vessel beneath the waters of Boston Harbor in the Commonwealth.

Zoe is an Autumn Fairy who first appeared in Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!, offering Spyro advice and serving as a checkpoint for him throughout each of the Realms he visits. She is particularly helpful to newer players and is essentially considered a tutorial.
personnages.jeux_phares: Beyond: Two Souls (2013) · Hitman 2 (2018) · Bully: Scholarship Edition (2008)

personnages.description:
Carley is one of the many main characters that appears in Telltale Games' The Walking Dead: Season One. She is a regional news reporter from Atlanta and a very skilled shooter. Carley's role is more active and she's never afraid to speak her mind. Having spent her time in war-zones as a correspondent, she presumably acquired basic knowledge of firearms and survival tactics that allows her to hold out during the outbreak.

Meeting Lee & Clementine in Macon, they later develop some kind of love relationship. Like the rest of the group, she cares about the members' welfare. Carley wants to save every survivor and give everyone a chance. Being very respectful and thoughtful, she reassures Lee that she will keep the secret to herself when he chooses to admit his past to her.

Not much is known about Carley's personal life, other than that she was raised Lutheran. The production crew drove to Macon to cover the Cherry Blossom Festival and that's when they were attacked by walkers. She was forced to watch her producer being eaten alive just a few feet away from her. Carley was saved by a guy called Doug.

Sadly, her life takes a turn for the worse as you get deeper into the story.
Glenn refers to characters or cast and crew members named "Glenn" or "Glen" throughout The Walking Dead franchise.
Diana refers to characters or cast and crew members named "Diana" throughout The Walking Dead franchise.

{{CharacterTransformer |style = {} |name = Rendon Howe |image = NPC-Arl Howe.jpg |px = 270x360px |title = Arl of Amaranthine After the Battle of Ostagar: Teyrn of Highever Arl of Denerim (disputed) |gender = Male |race = Human |class = Rogue |specialization = Assassin |rank = Origins: Boss Darkspawn Chronicles: Elite Boss |family = Tarleton Howe (father)[note] Padric Howe (father)[note] Eliane Bryland (wife) Nathaniel Howe (son) Delilah Howe (daughter) Thomas Howe (son) Unnamed grandson (by Delilah) Byron (uncle) Habren Bryland (niece) Leonas Bryland (brother-in-law) |affiliation = |location = Castle Cousland Arl of Denerim's Estate Dungeon |quests = Human Noble Origin Rescue the Queen Kill the Arl |voice = Tim Curry |appearances = Dragon Age: Origins Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening (mentioned) The Darkspawn Chronicles Dragon Age II (mentioned) Heroes of Dragon Age Dragon Age: Inquisition (mentioned) }} Arl Rendon Howe is an old friend of Teyrn Bryce Cousland and the Arl of Amaranthine. He is also the father of Nathaniel Howe, a companion in Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening.

{{CharacterTransformer |style = {} |name = Sten |image = Sten new.jpg |px = 270x360px |title = Karasaad (formerly) Sten (prior to 9:34 Dragon) Arishok (BioWare canon, as of 9:34 Dragon) |gender = Male |race = Qunari |class = Warrior |specialization = |rank = Darkspawn Chronicles: Boss |family = |affiliation = The Warden (conditional) Antaam |location = |quests = Origins: The Qunari Prisoner The Sword of the Beresaad Darkspawn Chronicles: Assault on the Palaces Kill the Qunari |voice = Mark Hildreth |appearances = Dragon Age: Origins The Darkspawn Chronicles Dragon Age II (mentioned) Dragon Age: Those Who Speak Dragon Age: Until We Sleep Heroes of Dragon Age Dragon Age: Inquisition (mentioned) }} Sten is a Qunari warrior of the Beresaad, the vanguard of the Antaam. Born atypical without horns, he is a stoic and disciplined man with a strong code of ethics, and the way he treats others depends on whether or not they have his respect, which he does not give easily. As with all Qunari appellations, "Sten" is a rank, not a name. He is a potential companion to the Warden and can only be recruited in Lothering.

{{CharacterTransformer |style = {} |name = Wynne |image = WynneEpilogue.png |px = 270x360px |title = Senior Enchanter Representative of the Aequitarians (conditional) Archmage (conditional) |gender = Female |race = Human |class = Mage |specialization = Spirit Healer |rank = Origins: Normal Darkspawn Chronicles: Boss |family = Rhys (son) |affiliation = Circle of Magi The Warden (conditional) College of the Aequitarians (conditional) |location = Kinloch Hold |quests = Origins: Wynne's Regret Darkspawn Chronicles: Slay the Healer Awakening: Ines the Botanist |voice = Susan Boyd Joyce |appearances = Dragon Age: Origins The Darkspawn Chronicles Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening Dragon Age: Asunder Heroes of Dragon Age Dragon Age: Inquisition (mentioned) }} Wynne is a mage of the Circle in Ferelden and a potential companion to the Warden in Dragon Age: Origins.

{{CharacterTransformer |style = {} |name = Zevran Arainai |image = ZevranBetter.png|Origins ZevranDAII.png|Dragon Age II |px = 270x360px |title = Antivan Crow (formerly) |gender = Male |race = Elf |class = Rogue |specialization = Assassin |rank = Origins: Normal Darkspawn Chronicles: Boss |affiliation = House Arainai (formerly) Antivan Crows (formerly) The Warden (conditional) Hawke (conditional) |quests = Origins: The Long Road Dragon Age II: A Murder of Crows Inquisition: A Missing Assassin Word from Zevran Arainai Evading the Crows |voice = Jon Curry |appearances = Dragon Age: Origins Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening (mentioned) The Darkspawn Chronicles Dragon Age II Dragon Age: The Silent Grove (mentioned) Heroes of Dragon Age Dragon Age: Inquisition (mentioned) }} Zevran Arainai (born c. 9:04–9:05 Dragon) is an elven Antivan rogue and accomplished assassin. He is a potential companion and a romance option for either female or male Warden. He gained his surname Arainai after being brought into House Arainai as a Crow recruit.

Helios is an artificial intelligence entity that is created by the unexpected merger of rival AI entities Daedalus and Icarus. The merger occurs as a result of JC Denton's actions at Vandenberg Air Force Base.
personnages.jeux_phares: Deus Ex (2000) · God of War III (2010) · Apotheon (2015)

personnages.description: Mickey Mouse, often referred to as King Mickey or The King, is the king of Disney Castle and Queen Minnie's husband. He travels the worlds battling the forces of darkness and is a Keyblade Master, and the chosen Keyblade wielder for the Realm of Darkness, though he follows the path of light. Originally believing that the darkness had to be eliminated, he eventually realized that light and darkness are interdependent and cannot exist without the other due to his encounters with Riku. Due to his quests—and thus, being away from his queen—he has no known children that will become the heirs to his kingdom. Mickey was voiced by Wayne Allwine up to , until his passing in 2009, with Bret Iwan taking over the role up to now. The Japanese version features a similar arrangement, although Takashi Aoyagi retired and voiced Mickey up to Kingdom Hearts III, with Takanori Hoshino taking over for the series so far.
personnages.jeux_phares: Kingdom Hearts II (2005) · Kingdom Hearts (2002) · Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep (2010)

personnages.premier_jeu: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
personnages.description: The Sculptor is a character in The Precursor Legacy who lives in Sandover Village. In the game, he relates to Jak and Daxter the fleeing of his muse to Misty Island, after which he offers them a power cell for retrieving it in the mission "Catch the Sculptor's muse". The duo succeeded in retrieving the elusive creature and received their reward. The Sculptor is a tall human male with spiked purple hair and a goatee, clad in safety visors and a sculpting apron and utility belt. He has a balance of personality between easy going and laid back, and anxious and seemingly depressed when without his pet.
personnages.premiere: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (2001)
personnages.jeux_phares: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice (2019) · Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (2001)

personnages.description: Rickert of Vinheim (ヴィンハイムのリッケルト) is a character in Dark Souls. He is a blacksmith by trade. He is voiced by Adam Sopp, who also voiced Vince of Thorolund, as well as the male Anri of Astora in Dark Souls III.
Vince of Thorolund (ヴィンス) is a minor character in Dark Souls. He is voiced by Adam Sopp, who also voiced Rickert of Vinheim, as well as the male Anri of Astora in Dark Souls III.

Laurentius of the Great Swamp (大沼のラレンティウス) is the basic Pyromancy trainer in Dark Souls. He is voiced by Andy Gathergood, who also voiced the Crestfallen Merchant, and Felkin the Outcast in Dark Souls II.

The Crestfallen Merchant is a character in Dark Souls. A pessimistic merchant, he peddles goods at Sen's Fortress. He is voiced by Andy Gathergood, who also voices Laurentius of the Great Swamp, and Felkin the Outcast in Dark Souls II.

is a sorcery trainer and character in Dark Souls. A soft-spoken, modest magician, Griggs claims to be the apprentice of Big Hat Logan. He is voiced by Blake Ritson, who also voices Royal Sorcerer Navlaan in Dark Souls II and Hawkwood the Deserter in Dark Souls III.
is a character and merchant who appears in Dark Souls. She is voiced by Charlie Cameron, who also voiced Quelaag's Sister and Sieglinde of Catarina.
Quelaag's Sister, also known as "The White Lady" and "The Fair Lady", is a character in Dark Souls. She is voiced by Charlie Cameron, who also voiced Reah of Thorolund and Sieglinde of Catarina.

Sieglinde of Catarina (カタリナのジークリンデ) is a character in Dark Souls. The daughter of Siegmeyer of Catarina, Sieglinde travels to Lordran in search of her adventurous father. She is voiced by Charlie Cameron, who also voiced Quelaag's Sister and Reah of Thorolund.

Gwynevere (グウィネヴィア), Princess of Sunlight, also known as Gwynevere, Queen of Sunlight, is a character in Dark Souls, serving as the leader of the Princess's Guard covenant. She is also a mentioned character in Dark Souls III. She is voiced by Clare Corbett, who also voiced the Undead Female Merchant and Crossbreed Priscilla.
Solaire of Astora (太陽の戦士ソラール) is a character in Dark Souls. He is voiced by Daniel Flynn, who also voiced Vamos and the Giant Blacksmith as well as Blue Sentinel Targray in Dark Souls II.
Oswald of Carim (カリムのオズワルド) is a character in Dark Souls. He is also known as Oswald the Pardoner. He is voiced by David Gant, who also voices Aldia, Scholar of the First Sin in Dark Souls II.
, also known as Princess Dusk, is a character and merchant in Dark Souls. She is voiced by Emma Pierson, who also voiced Anastacia of Astora.

Anastacia of Astora (アストラのアナスタシア), also known as The Ash Maiden, is a Fire Keeper in Dark Souls. She keeps the bonfire in Firelink Shrine lit. Anastacia is voiced by Emma Pierson, who also voiced Dusk of Oolacile.
Alvina of the Darkroot Wood (白猫アルヴィナ), commonly referred to as Alvina, is a character in Dark Souls who acts the leader of the Forest Hunter covenant. She is voiced by Ève Karpf.

is a character and optional boss in Dark Souls. Found in Anor Londo behind a statue that reveals a hidden path if the Chosen Undead is wearing the Darkmoon Seance Ring, he can be talked to, unseen, through a fog wall, acting as leader of the Blades of the Darkmoon covenant. Passing through the fog wall will turn him hostile and trigger his boss battle.

is a character in Dark Souls. First met in Sen's Fortress, from which he relocates to Firelink Shrine, he is a merchant of advanced sorceries, including new ones upon following his questline into The Duke's Archives. Voiced by Ian Thompson in his final role before his passing in 2022, Logan is also a mentioned character in Dark Souls II and a mentioned character in Dark Souls III, although Dark Souls II refers to him as an unnamed "master sorcerer" due to his name being forgotten in Drangleic.

Quelana of Izalith (クラーナ) is a character and merchant in Dark Souls. Found in the swamp at the bottom of Blighttown if special conditions are met, she is one of the Witch of Izalith's "Daughters of Chaos", and acts as a seller and trainer of pyromancies. She is voiced by Jenny Funnel, who also voiced the Darkmoon Knightess in the same game, Yuria and Selen Vinland in Demon's Souls, Annalise and Iosefa in Bloodborne, and Karla and the Old Woman of Londor in Dark Souls III.
Shiva of the East (東のシバ) is a character in Dark Souls. He is voiced by Kwei Lin Hsu.
Domhnall of Zena (ゼナのドーナル) is a merchant in Dark Souls. He is voiced by Matt Morgan, who also voiced the Crestfallen Warrior.

Siegmeyer of Catarina (カタリナのジークマイヤー) is a recurring character in Dark Souls. He is a jolly, polite, and somewhat bumbling knight. He is voiced by Miles Richardson, who also voices the Undead Male Merchant, as well as Siegward of Catarina in Dark Souls III.
is a character in Dark Souls. He is a primordial serpent who seeks a human successor to Gwyn, Lord of Cinder. He is voiced by Peter Marinker, who also voiced Darkstalker Kaathe and Eingyi.

Andre of Astora (アストラのアンドレイ) is a character in Dark Souls. He is a blacksmith that will likely prove invaluable to the player throughout the game. Andre is voiced by Sean Barrett, who also voiced Ingward and Petrus of Thorolund.
Petrus of Thorolund (ソルロンドのペトルス) is a character in Dark Souls. He is voiced by Sean Barrett, who also voiced Ingward and Andre; and Grandahl in Dark Souls II, and Andre and Hodrick in Dark Souls III.
Ingward (イングウァード) is a character in Dark Souls. He is voiced by Sean Barrett, who also voiced Andre and Petrus, Grandahl in Dark Souls II, as well as Andre and Hodrick in Dark Souls III.
Patches (鉄板のパッチ), also known as Trusty Patches, is a character in Dark Souls. He is an opportunistic trickster with a strong animosity towards clerics.

Gray Fox, real name Frank Jaeger, was a mercenary and former agent of U.S. Special Forces Unit FOXHOUND. Originally a child soldier, Jaeger was the only operative in FOXHOUND to achieve the codename "Fox," the unit's highest commendation, and was decorated five times. Fox was Solid Snake's comrade-in-arms and friend during the Outer Heaven Uprising, but his loyalty to renegade commander Big Boss forced him into combat with Snake during the Zanzibar Land Disturbance. Left near death following an intense battle, his body was recovered, forcibly outfitted with a powered exoskeleton and subjected to experimental gene therapy. Fox later confronted Snake during the Shadow Moses Incident, in the guise of the Cyborg Ninja, before dying at the hands of Liquid Snake and Metal Gear REX.

Alan Wake was born and raised in New York City. He developed a passion for writing at a young age, eventually leading to a successful novelist career. His most famous works are thriller novels, which have earned him a large and dedicated following. Despite his success, Alan struggles with writer's block and personal issues, including a strained relationship with his wife, Alice.

In an attempt to overcome his writer's block, Alan and Alice take a vacation to the idyllic town of Bright Falls. However, their peaceful retreat quickly turns into a nightmare when Alice disappears under mysterious circumstances. Alan discovers pages of a manuscript he doesn't remember writing, detailing events that start to come true in real life.

As he searches for Alice, Alan encounters dark supernatural forces known as the "Taken," shadowy entities controlled by a malevolent presence called the "Darkness." He learns that the town and its surroundings are influenced by this dark power, which has trapped him in a nightmarish reality where his own writing becomes a weapon and a tool for survival.

A crucial figure in Alan's journey is Thomas Zane, a poet who lived in Bright Falls decades earlier and had a similar encounter with the Darkness. Zane’s writings and his struggle against the Darkness provide Alan with clues and guidance on how to fight supernatural forces.

In the end, Alan realizes that to save Alice and stop the Darkness, he must make a significant sacrifice. He writes a conclusion to the horror story he is trapped in, allowing Alice to escape while he remains in the dark, nightmarish world beneath Cauldron Lake. This act of self-sacrifice shows his character's deep love for his wife and his determination to end the cycle of terror.
personnages.jeux_phares: Alan Wake (2010) · Quantum Break (2016) · Alan Wake's American Nightmare (2012)

personnages.description: Jiminy Cricket is a character that appears in many of the Kingdom Hearts series. Jiminy is solely responsible for recording the events of Sora's journey.
personnages.jeux_phares: Kingdom Hearts II (2005) · Kingdom Hearts (2002) · Kingdom Hearts III (2019)

personnages.description: Piglet is one of the characters residing in the Hundred Acre Wood. He appears in Kingdom Hearts, Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, Kingdom Hearts II and Kingdom Hearts III. He is best friends with the world's main character, Winnie the Pooh.
personnages.jeux_phares: Kingdom Hearts II (2005) · Kingdom Hearts (2002) · Kingdom Hearts III (2019)

personnages.description:
Matt is the high school's star linebacker, but he isn't necessarily the sharpest tool in the box. He's hoping for a sports scholarship to a top college, because his GPA isn't going to cut the mustard.

He mostly plays the part of the big friendly giant - but when Matt stays red, it's best to stay out of his way...

Matt is fiercely loyal to his girlfriend Emily... maybe even too loyal. Their relationship could be described as being a little one-way: when Emily says something, Matt does it.
personnages.jeux_phares: The Walking Dead: Season Two (2013) · Until Dawn (2015) · Alone in the Dark (2008)

personnages.alias: アルバート・ウェスカー
personnages.description:
Albert Wesker is one of the central characters in the Resident Evil franchise by Capcom (or Biohazard in Japan). He was introduced in the original game and was the captain of U.S. police team STARS. Initially introduced as a supporting character in the first game, he has been one of the primary antagonists throughout the series, where he usually manipulates story events behind-the-scenes. 

He was a man who sought to replace the entire race through mass extinction and forced evolution, these thoughts causing Wesker to become very power-hungry. To this end, he was affiliated with the Umbrella Corporation as one of its most promising researchers, and at the same time participated in illicit activities by going undercover as S.T.A.R.S. captain in Raccoon City. After everyone found out about his betrayal, Wesker fakes his death and gains superhuman powers from an experimental variant of the Progenitor virus. He then starts working with Umbrella's mysterious rival company, TRICELL, until his defeat in Resident Evil 5.

Chris Redfield was the one who found out that Wesker worked for Umbrella, killing his plans. That's why he started to hate Chris, wanting nothing more than to destroy the guy. 
In terms of personality, Wesker was a cunning, deceptive, and highly intelligent bio-terrorist, usually preferring to observe the action from behind the scenes and then strike when the opportunity presented itself.

(born c.1984) is the daughter of former President Graham. In 2004, Graham was victim to an international conspiracy to turn influential American citizens into hosts for a mind-control parasite, Las Plagas, and was rescued in a classified government operation.

was a Spanish biologist native to an isolated region of Spain. After time elsewhere, supposedly Madrid, he was recruited by Osmund Saddler into Los Iluminados' research project on the Plaga parasite. While suspicious of the project, he continued to work on what became clear was illegal human testing and bioweapons research. By 2004 he had made contact with an anonymous organization, offering them the seed of Los Iluminados' labour in exchange for his safety. On attempting to undermine Saddler's efforts, however, Serra himself was ultimately killed.
is a U.S. federal agent for the Field Operations Support (FOS) and often works with former USSTRATCOM's agent, now Division of Security Operations operative Leon Scott Kennedy.

was a Spanish nobleman from Valdelobos. A descendent of the 15th century noble warrior, Gregorio Salazar I, Ramón inherited the position of castellano alongside his peerage, a duty more important to the family than the peerage itself. As the 21st century came about, Salazar left his Catholic faith behind and converted to Los Iluminados, a cult led by Osmund Saddler, who had access to bioweapons research and was interested in Las Plagas. Although his diminutive stature resembled that of a ten-year-old, and his grey hair and wrinkled face gave him the appearance of an elderly man, he was only 20 years old.

Father was a Catholic priest who ran the church in Valdelobos, an isolated mountainous region of Spain, and chief of the local village. Méndez fell to the influence of bio-weapons developer and terrorist Osmund Saddler, who converted people to his cult as a means of control. Fr. Méndez led the initial hunt for USSTRATCOM agent Leon S. Kennedy, Ashley Graham, Dr. Luis Serra, and Ada Wong as they made their way through his village, but was ultimately killed, allowing the four to make their way into Salazar's castle. Some of Méndez's distinguishing characteristics included his imposing stature and trench coat, his artificial left eye, an extraordinary resistance to firearms, being fast and quiet enough despite his size to sneak up on Leon at least twice, and superhuman strength. He was also a fluent English L2 speaker, and collected academic writings for his personal library.

For other characters named "Jack" see Jack (disambiguation) was an agent for the 3rd Organization during the War on Terror, and a supporter of Dr. Albert Wesker. Previously a soldier within USSOCOM known as "Silverdax," he was forced into retirement after a 2002 mission to South America with USSTRATCOM agent Leon S. Kennedy. During his employment within The Organization, Krauser took part in the infiltration of Los Iluminados to obtain a Plaga parasite. Krauser was killed in late 2004 during the rescue operation of Ashley Graham.

Lord was the leader of Los Iluminados, a neopagan cult and paramilitary organisation. He was a bio-weapons research chief who resided in an isolated Spanish region. In the early 2000s, Saddler's leadership ensured the cult's dominance in the region through the weaponisation of the mind-controlling Plaga parasites to suit his plans for world domination. He was killed in 2004 during a USSTRATCOM mission to rescue Ashley Graham, the President's daughter whom Saddler's organisation had taken hostage.
Marius was an unfortunate soul who was caught up in the return of the Prime Evils. He would pay a heavy price for his involvement.

Tidus (Tee-dus) is the main protagonist of Final Fantasy X. He can be acquired as a Creature Creator ally in the International + Last Mission and HD versions of Final Fantasy X-2 and plays a pivotal role in the extended universe audio drama and novella. He is a rising star blitzball player from Zanarkand and the son of major blitzball star Jecht. After the gargantuan monster known as Sin attacks his hometown, Tidus is transported to the world of Spira. Lost, confused, and seemingly out of place, Tidus meets a newly fledged summoner named Yuna and her guardians. Yuna is to set out on a pilgrimage to put an end to Sin and, by joining Yuna on her pilgrimage, Tidus hopes he will find his way home. Tidus is upbeat and initially childish and naive to the world of Spira. He is also selfless and will do what he believes is right, even if he doesn't think it through first. Throughout the pilgrimage, he matures and becomes more level-headed and grounded. Tidus wields swords and shields in battle. His Sphere Grid path grants him Wht Magic concerned with time status effects, such as Haste and Slow, and also improves his Agility, Evasion, and Accuracy. His Celestial Weapon, the Caladbolg, deals more damage depending on how high his HP is. His Overdrive is Swordplay, dealing physical damage, which can be improved by correct player button timing, and he learns new Swordplay abilities by frequently using them. Tidus is one of three characters who can fight underwater, along with Wakka and Ri

Wakka is a playable character in Final Fantasy X who is a blitzball player and one of Yuna's guardians. He appears in a smaller role Final Fantasy X-2, as well as Final Fantasy X: Eternal Calm and Final Fantasy X -Will-. Wakka is the only playable character from Final Fantasy X who cannot be recruited in Final Fantasy X-2: International and Final Fantasy X-2 HD Remaster. Wakka is the first person Tidus meets after washing up on Besaid and befriends Tidus after being impressed by his blitzball skills. He is the captain of the Besaid Aurochs, a team that has never won a game. He grew up with Yuna along with Lulu and views her as a younger sister. His late brother, Chappu, was a Crusader who lost his life while wielding a machina weapon. Because of this, Wakka harbors a huge resentment for machina and bigotry towards the Al Bhed, who use them, and uses his staunch following of the teachings of Yevon (which forbid machina) to further rationalize his hatred. His worldview broadens during Yuna's pilgrimage and, despite his bigotry, Wakka is a loyal friend and helps Tidus come to grips with Spira. Wakka is a ranged attacker and uses his blitzballs and armbands in battle. His Sphere Grid path grants him high Accuracy, several Skill abilities that inflict negative status effects, and a few Blk Magic spells. His Celestial Weapon, World Champion, deals more damage the higher his current HP is. His Overdrive, Slots, deals various damaging effects with his blitzball depending on slot inpu

Eva is one of the two overarching protagonists (alongside Sparda) of the Devil May Cry franchise. She was the human wife of Sparda, mother to the hybrid twins Dante and Vergil, and paternal grandmother of Nero. She most often appears as a photo on Dante's desk, but has a voice in the first Devil May Cry game. Later in the series, Eva makes her physical debut in a flashback in the Devil May Cry 3 (manga) and in-game debut in Devil May Cry 5, again in a flashback. Despite her importance as a factor to the paths her children take in life, little is known about Eva.
personnages.jeux_phares: Devil May Cry 5 (2019) · DmC: Devil May Cry (2013) · Grim Fandango (1998)

personnages.description: Cynthia is a playable child character in Fire Emblem Awakening. She is the future daughter of Sumia.

personnages.jeux_phares: The Walking Dead: Season Two (2013) · Beyond: Two Souls (2013) · Intruders: Hide and Seek (2019)

personnages.description: Private Dominic "Dom" Santiago ES was a Gear in the COG Army during the Pendulum Wars, Locust War, Stranded Insurgency, and Lambent Pandemic. He was the younger brother of Carlos Santiago and childhood friend of Marcus Fenix, both war heroes of the Pendulum Wars. Santiago joined the army as a Commando and took part in Operation Leveler to obtain schematics for the Hammer of Dawn, which would later guarantee victory for the COG but resulted in the death of his brother Carlos. On Emergence Day, Santiago lost both his children. His wife, Maria Santiago, developed PTSD and went missing. Fourteen years after E-Day, Santiago pardoned Marcus Fenix from Jacinto Maximum Security Prison and recruited him into Delta-One. After finally finding his wife, he was forced to euthanize Maria as she had become a victim of torture by the Locust Horde. Santiago developed depression, but continued to fight during the Stranded Insurgency and Lambent Pandemic. When the COG collapsed following the abandonment of Chairman Richard Prescott, Santiago joined the rest of Delta aboard the CNV Sovereign, serving as a member of a rapid response force that defended former COG communities against the Lambent. In 17 A.E., Prescott returned from the secret island facility of Azura with the revelation that Marcus Fenix's father, Professor Adam Fenix, was alive and had created the Imulsion Countermeasure Weapon as a solution to the Lambent problem. With Queen Myrrah capturing the island and imprisoning Adam Fenix,
personnages.jeux_phares: Gears of War (2006) · Gears of War 2 (2008) · Gears of War 3 (2011)

personnages.description: Private Augustus Cole, also known as Gus or his Thrashball nickname "Cole Train", is a Gear in the COG Army and a former Thrashball player. Best known for playing with the Hanover Cougars as defensive lineman, Cole later joined the army as a Gear after his parents were killed by the Locust Horde on Emergence Day. His announcement of retiring from Thrashball and joining the war effort caused a massive spike in enlistments. During the majority of the Locust War, Cole fought alongside Cpl. Damon Baird. Cole rejected every military promotion that had been offered under the grounds that having rank was not going to affect how many Locust he could kill. As part of Delta-One, Cole became part of the most reliable squad of Gears available to the COG, fighting on the frontlines of every major operation near the end of the Locust War, and continued fighting for the COG as part of Delta after the relocation to Vectes, fighting Stranded Insurgents, the new threat of the Lambent Pandemic and the rise of the Swarm.
personnages.jeux_phares: Gears of War (2006) · Gears of War 2 (2008) · Gears of War 3 (2011)

personnages.description: Corporal Damon S. Baird (COG Tags CSID: 06059-81111-96) is a Gear of the Coalition of Ordered Governments Army and an expert in several technical, mechanical, and scientific fields. He also appears to be an expert in collecting and analyzing Locust weapons, other equipment, artifacts and documents. He joined the COG Army on Emergence Day, and soon after met Augustus Cole, who became his best friend. Fourteen years later, he was a member of Alpha Squad during the Lightmass Offensive, but joined Delta Squad along with Cole after the rest of the squad was killed. After the successful conclusion to the offensive, he was assigned to lead Sigma-One with Cole, taking part in several battles against the Locust. During Operation: Hollow Storm, he once again rejoined Delta, and fought through the campaign to sink Jacinto. He joined the rest of the COG in its evacuation to Port Farrall and later Vectes, where the COG was forced to deal with the Stranded Insurgency, and later the Lambent Pandemic, during which Baird was often on the front lines helping formulate plans with the rest of Delta and Command. When the COG collapsed, Baird joined the rest of Delta aboard the CNV Sovereign as part of the rapid response force that would assist several settlements the remnants of the COG had set up on the mainland.
personnages.jeux_phares: Gears of War (2006) · Gears of War 2 (2008) · Gears of War 3 (2011)

personnages.description: Colonel Victor Hoffman ES SM was a Gear officer and the Chief of Defense Staff of the Coalition of Ordered Governments during the Pendulum Wars and Locust War, and former Director of Special Forces, answering only to Chairman Richard Prescott. Hoffman hated being promoted so high, preferring to remain a frontline Gear. He is a battlefield commander, and has fought alongside his fellow Gears in the Pendulum Wars, the Locust War, and the Lambent Pandemic. A military man to the core, Hoffman demands discipline and sacrifice from those under his command. Hoffman's strict adherence to these ideals has caused him to cross swords with fellow Gear, Marcus Fenix. He made his reputation with the Siege of Anvil Gate, and later further increased it with the Battle of Aspho Fields. During the Locust War, Hoffman became the Chief of the COG Defense Staff by being the only high-ranking officer to remain alive, and led the COG Army for most of the Locust War. He planned the Lightmass Offensive and Operation: Hollow Storm, and did his best to hold the COG together with Prescott on the island of Vectes after the sinking of Jacinto. There, he resumed a relationship with old comrade, Bernadette Mataki, and led the COG army against the Stranded Insurgency and Lambent Pandemic. When Prescott abandoned the COG, Hoffman briefly led the government with Cpt. Quentin Michaelson and Commander Miran Trescu. However, they could not hold the COG together against the Lambent and fell apart, with several gro
personnages.jeux_phares: Gears of War (2006) · Gears of War 2 (2008) · Gears of War 3 (2011)

personnages.description: :This article is about the character that appears in the Original Timeline. For the one in the MachineGames reboot, see Caroline Becker (MachineGames). Caroline Becker was the late founder and leader of the Kreisau Circle, or at the very least the Kreisau Circle of Isenstadt, in Wolfenstein. She is the Kreisau Circle mission giver in the Midtown hub map. She is one of the few characters that was adapted into the reboot of the series by MachineGames.

Jade Aldemir is a major character in Dying Light. She was a runner for The Tower and was once known as the popular kickboxer "The Scorpion" before the outbreak occurred. She is the older sister of Rahim Aldemir. She is voiced by Nazneen Contractor.
personnages.jeux_phares: Dying Light (2015) · Beyond Good & Evil (2003) · Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age (2017)

personnages.description: Prince Aidan of Khanduras, later known as the Dark Wanderer, was the eldest son of King Leoric of Khanduras. Once a warrior, he later became a vessel for the Prime Evil Diablo.
personnages.jeux_phares: Diablo II (2000) · Overkill's The Walking Dead (2018)

He assists the Crimson Raiders in maintaining the rebel city. His sister, Ellie, maintains a garage in The Dust. He also maintains the Sanctu

:This article is for the character. For the boss, see Mary (boss). Mary Shepherd-Sunderland is the late wife of James Sunderland. The couple had vacationed in Silent Hill a few years prior to the events of Silent Hill 2. Mary was a kind, sweet young woman who spent the last moments of her life in emotional turmoil, distress and anguish after being stricken with a terminal disease.
personnages.jeux_phares: Silent Hill 2 (2001) · Rage 2 (2019) · Rusty Lake Hotel (2015)

personnages.description: Peter Pan is the flying boy of Neverland, a place where children never grow up. He is the leader of the Lost Boys and best friends with a little fairy called Tinker Bell. He first appeared in Disney's Peter Pan. Peter Pan has appeared in most of the main series games, aside from Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days and Kingdom Hearts coded.
personnages.jeux_phares: Kingdom Hearts II (2005) · Kingdom Hearts (2002) · Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep (2010)

personnages.description: Minnie Mouse is the queen of Disney Castle, who rules the peaceful kingdom alongside King Mickey. Her first appearance was in Disney's Plane Crazy. Despite being a queen, she rules the kingdom with equality to her citizens and shows no pride to her royal status. However, she has not bore Mickey an heir or heiress to his kingdom yet due to his constant quests and voyages.
personnages.jeux_phares: Kingdom Hearts II (2005) · Kingdom Hearts (2002) · Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep (2010)

personnages.description: Tal Rasha was a powerful Horadric Mage, and the original leader of the order. He became the host for Baal, Lord of Destruction. Few Sorcerers have been able to reach the same levels of fame that he has.

Tyrael, formerly the Archangel of Justice, now the Aspect of Wisdom, is a mortal angel. He is a stalwart defender of Sanctuary and mankind, but is considered a renegade by the Angiris Council. If not for his actions, both the mortal realm and its inhabitants would have fallen to darkness long ago.
Dul'Mephistos, the Lord of Hatred, commonly referred to as Mephisto, is one of the three Prime Evils.
Warriv was a caravan master who helped a group of heroes in their pursuit of the Dark Wanderer.

Akara is the high priestess of the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye, serving as its spiritual leader. Akara is a quiet, dignified woman, who intones rather than speaks. She is naturally suspicious of outsiders. Deckard Cain described her as being soft-spoken, inscrutable, and wise. She believes that more women are needed to fight against the enemies of Sanctuary.
Kashya is the field captain of the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye.
Charsi is a blacksmith.

Gheed is a traveling merchant. He is a large blonde man with a bushy mustache and beard. Though he gives off a jovial manner, a calculating glint can be seen in his eyes. Necromancers are the bane of his life, but for anyone else, he'll greet them with a warm smile and a firm handshake. Gheed is willing to buy and sell almost anything. He has a strict "no returns" policy.
Drognan is a resident of Lut Gholein.

Alkor was a potion-dealer who resided in Kurast. Alkor was loathe to be interrupted or disturbed, but if one managed to get his attention, he did his best to aid them for as long as his battered wits allow him to remain focused. He was interested in Necromancers, and maintained a grimoire, along with a library of tomes—heretical, exegetical, hermeneutical, and pharmaceutical.
Andariel, the Maiden of Anguish is one of the Lesser Evils and the only female demon of the Great Evils.

Blood Raven (originally known as Moreina) was a member of the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye. She played a role in Diablo's defeat during the Darkening of Tristram, but fell into Hell's thrall in the aftermath.
Flavie is a Rogue, and member of the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye.
Fara is a blacksmith and former Paladin who resides in Lut Gholein.
Atma is a tavern keeper of Lut Gholein. Atma has dark hair. She is a strong-willed, beautiful woman, and many men are aware of it.

Elzix is an ex-bandit lord and resident of Lut Gholein. He has keen ears, and knows a lot of what goes on in the desert of Aranoch. In addition to a missing eye, Elzix's face is covered in scars. A furtive, sly man, he watches everyone like a fox would chickens.
Meshif was a former ship captain.
Jerhyn was the sultan of Lut Gholein.
Izual was a fallen angel-turned servant of the Burning Hells.
Asheara was the leader of the mercenary company known the Iron Wolves.
Ormus is a Mage of the Taan Clan.
Natalya is a former Assassin-turned Demon Hunter.
Al'Diabolos, the Lord of Terror, more commonly known as Diablo, is the youngest of the three Prime Evils, and the titular main antagonist of the Diablo game series.
Hadriel is an archangel of the High Heavens.

A bit older than the rest of the group, Josh is something of an older brother figure to Chris. He loves taking the helm, organizing cool events and making sure everyone has an awesome time.

Josh definitely has a bit of a party-animal streak (honed in his freshman year), but his warm and friendly personality will win everybody around in the end.

Lieutenant General Shepherd was a general in the United States Army in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 who commanded the United States Marine Corps, U.S. Army Rangers, Task Force 141 and his own elite army that was known as Shadow Company. He started out as a main character for the player in Modern Warfare 2 only to reveal himself as the main antagonist of the game and the grand architect of World War III. He wielded a .44 Magnum as his signature weapon, though the player could only acquire it in the level, "Museum".

Corporal Dunn is a U.S. Army Ranger with Hunter Two-One, 1st Battalion, 75th Ranger Regiment who fought under the command of Sgt. Foley. He fought in Afghanistan in 2016 against OpFor forces and participated in the opening attacks of the Russo-American War.

Ariel is the rebellious and strong-willed princess in the underwater kingdom of Atlantica. She appears as an ally, party member, and a summon/link throughout the Kingdom Hearts series. She is the youngest daughter of King Triton and his late wife Queen Athena and one of seven sisters. Ariel previously lived at the palace in Atlantica, but, as of Kingdom Hearts II, she has become human and married Prince Eric.
personnages.jeux_phares: Kingdom Hearts II (2005) · Kingdom Hearts (2002) · Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2 (2001)

personnages.description: Sebastian is a hermit crab with a Jamaican accent, who is in service of King Triton in Atlantica. He appears in Kingdom Hearts, Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, and Kingdom Hearts II. He is normally the one who tries to keep Ariel out of trouble, and the one to keep her mind off the human world. He is also the Court Composer.

personnages.description: The Boss, also known as The Joy, The Mother of Special Forces, Mercury Lady and Voyevoda (Russian: Воевода, "Warlord"), was a renowned American soldier, founder and leader of the Cobra Unit, the biological mother of Ocelot, and mentor and mother figure to Naked Snake. In June 1944, during World War II, she led the Cobra Unit to victory at the Battle of Normandy. Together with Naked Snake, she developed the technique of CQC.

personnages.description: The End was the legendary "Ancient Sniper" of the Cobra Unit. He was over 100 years old when he was defeated by Naked Snake in 1964.

personnages.description: "The Sergeant", or Sarge at times, was a soldier of the Terran Confederacy. His subordinate, Lester, did not share the same taste in music as he did, but the sergeant controlled the music selection since he was in charge. The Sergeant should not be confused with the Drill Sergeant in the Episode III cutscene, The Ambush. Both characters are voiced by James Page.

Cloud Strife is a non-playable character in the Kingdom Hearts series, originating from the Final Fantasy universe. He is the main character in Final Fantasy VII and a supporting character in the Kingdom Hearts series.

personnages.description: The Fisherman is a character in The Precursor Legacy. As his name implies, he is a fisherman from Sandover Village, though is only ever seen in Forbidden Jungle, where he hopelessly attempts to catch fish to no avail. He is the owner of a fishing boat, which he formerly used to fish on open waters, as well as a speedboat, which Jak and Daxter used to travel to Misty Island. He and the Farmer are the two suppliers of dietary mainstays for the village, those being fish and yakow meat, respectively. Also like the Farmer, he was one of the earliest known victims of local harassment by lurkers as part of their increasing aggression against the village from the surrounding areas.

personnages.description: Sunny Emmerich was a child prodigy in computer programming, the daughter of Olga Gurlukovich and the adopted daughter of Dr. Hal "Otacon" Emmerich.
personnages.jeux_phares: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots (2008) · Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (2013) · PaRappa the Rapper (1996)

personnages.description: Charlie Cutter is a character in the Uncharted series. He appears in the first half of Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception, serving as the overall tritagonist of the game, and is subsequently mentioned in Uncharted 4: A Thief's End. He is an English fortune hunter who was initially believed to be an antagonist, but he is soon revealed to be an ally and associate of Nathan Drake, Victor Sullivan and Chloe Frazer. Charlie Cutter is voiced by Graham McTavish, who has previously voiced Uncharted 2: Among Thieves main antagonist Zoran Lazarević.

Talbot was a high-ranking agent of Katherine Marlowe's Hermetic Order and its combat section, as well as acting as Marlowe's right-hand man. Talbot appears as the main antagonist in Drake's Deception, acting as a major foil to protagonist Nathan Drake (to which he could be considered the main antagonist specifically for the latter). In addition, he also appears as a playable skin in the multiplayer modes of Drake's Deception and A Thief's End. In all of his appearances, Talbot is voice acted and mo-capped by Robin Atkin Downes.

Rameses was a Yemeni pirate, self-proclaimed businessman, and the leader of a pirate gang based in the Indian Ocean. Despite being a pirate, Rameses claims he's a "nice guy" on account that he spares Drake's life, instead of killing him as ordered. Rameses is a supporting character and the tertiary antagonist of Drake's Deception, having been hired by main antagonist Katherine Marlowe to kill protagonist Nathan Drake. He is also a playable skin in the multiplayer modes of Drake's Deception and A Thief's End. In both of his appearances, Rameses is voiced and motion-captured by Sayed Badreya.
