personnages.description: is a Human-type Earthling/Saiyan hybrid, the firstborn child of Vegeta and Bulma and the older brother of Bulla.
personnages.jeux_phares: Jump Force (2019) · Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Z (2014) · Dragon Ball Z: Super Butouden (1993)

personnages.description: , more specifically , recognized as , is the prince of the fallen Saiyan race and the husband of Bulma, the father of Trunks and Bulla, the eldest son of King Vegeta, as well as one of the main characters of the Dragon Ball series. Regal, egotistical, and full of pride, Vegeta was once a ruthless, cold-blooded warrior and outright killer, but later abandoned his position in the Frieza Force for a peaceful life on Earth. He would repeatedly fight alongside Universe 7's most powerful warriors in order to protect Earth and his family, as well as to surpass Goku in power. Vegeta's strong character development has received high praise and is regarded as the biggest in the series. He initially debuted as the main antagonist of the Vegeta Saga but progressed into a more anti-heroic tritagonist role for the rest of Dragon Ball Z. Since the Majin Buu Saga and going into Dragon Ball Super, Vegeta has been the main deuteragonist/secondary protagonist behind Goku.
personnages.jeux_phares: Jump Force (2019) · Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Z (2014) · Dragon Ball Z: Super Butouden (1993)

personnages.description: Brawl is rage incarnate. It's not that he doesn't love his job—he does—it's just that he has so little control over the destruction he brings to the battlefield. His rage is so great, it's been suggested that when he combines with his fellow Combaticons to form Bruticus, it's his rage alone that fuels the titan. But fortunately for Brawl, he has no problem with this. Best to love what you aren't capable of controlling in the first place, eh?
personnages.jeux_phares: Transformers: War for Cybertron (2010) · Transformers: The Game (2007)

personnages.description: Michael Thorton is the playable character and main protagonist in the game Alpha Protocol. He plays a major role in the world crisis following the crash of a commercial airliner. While he is inexperienced in the field, Thorton shows promising skill. When Thorton finds himself cut off from his contacts, he must rely on every weapon in his arsenal in order to keep the peace. Thorton can actually be customized to the player's liking to a certain degree.

is the Senior Intelligence Analyst of Alpha Protocol in the game of the same name. His personal intelligence is genius, having degrees in economics, physical science and physiology in College. Parker was however, a slacker when it came to school. He always tried to get the minimum passing grade and take the least number of tests in order to graduate.

Albatross is a high-ranking member (possibly a leader as a whole or a leader of a section) of the G22 faction in Alpha Protocol. His bodyguard (and potentially his adopted daughter) is Sis. He and his faction play a role in the Taipei and Moscow hubs (particularly in Moscow), and he may also appear in the endgame. Albatross encounters Michael Thorton in Moscow and in Taipei during Operation Blood Feud and during Operation True Heirs. He can become an ally at various points in both operations as well as throughout Thorton's final operation.

Conrad Marburg is the Chief of Operations for the Veteran Combat Initiative. He is also an elite member of Halbech's inner circle, working directly for Henry Leland. He travels to Rome on behalf of Halbech to help carry out their plans to start a global conflict for profit. Marburg encounters Michael Thorton in Rome during Operation Deus Vult. He and Thorton quickly become adversaries as they fight to meet their opposing goals.

The Gelateria Nico Proprietor, also known as the Gelato Man, is the supposed NSA Agent that runs the gelato shop/NSA post Michael Thorton visits in Rome. Thorton comes guided by former NSA Agent Mina Tang ready to infiltrate the NSA's computer systems established inside, only to find this man clueless to his NSA passphrase. The Proprietor's shop is already unsanitary, and to make matters worse in the eyes of Michael Thorton, the man himself is equally unsanitary. Upon seeing him, Michael witnesses him scratching his head with the ice cream scooper, licking it openly to add to the agent's disbelief. The proprietor's name is unmentioned. There is no dossier information available on him, and although his actions with you do vary in the one mission he appears in, he does not have an individual profile or a reputation count. There are a few ways the mission goes: *You execute him, either on-sight and unprovoked or out of panic when he reaches under the counter to offer a gelato cone. *You, by making him uneasy, cause him to pull out a shotgun causing Mike to kill him in self-defense. *You depart without incident. This mission, along with the events of the CIA Listening Post infiltration and the mission to identify Jibril al-Bara, will determine how Conrad Marburg and Henry Leland see the player's actions during the Rome hub, determining their commentary on whether one managed to stay under the radar or simply started killing. It is never confirmed if the man is actually an NSA aff

is an information broker and a trader in the underground market. He operates locally in Moscow and also through the Clearinghouse. He is a contact of Michael Thorton's as well as a vendor on the Clearinghouse.

Henry Leland is a Chief Executive Officer of Halbech Corporation and the main antagonist in Alpha Protocol. He is willing to start World War III to increase profits for his company no matter the cost. He used his contacts with Alpha Protocol to bring benefit in Halbech's interests.

Hong Shi (Chinese: 洪石, Hóng Shí) is a high-ranking member of the White Oak Mountain Triad in Taipei, essentially the leader in charge of the gang with few higher-ups. He holds considerable control over the Triad gang in the Taiwanese capital, allowing him to oversee and undertake various criminal operations of his choosing. He also holds a considerable amount of influence and information as a result of his position. Michael Thorton possibly first encounters Hong Shi early in his mission in Taipei. The (rogue) Alpha Protocol Agent seeks out the Triad boss in an attempt to gain information regarding the assassination plot against Taiwanese President Ronald Sung, as well as any information he could obtain regarding the Halbech Corporation's involvement and activity in Taipei.

Konstantin Brayko (Russian: Константин Брайко, Konstantin Brayko) is a major character in Alpha Protocol, appearing as the main (though not necessarily final) boss fight in the Moscow hub. A cold, cunning and extremely dangerous head of a large mafia, Brayko is the person of interest Michael searches for when he finds how Moscow was used as the shipping route for the missiles.

is an intelligence analyst at Alpha Protocol, as well as the main deuteragonist in the game. Her primary task in the organization is encrypting and decrypting information. Her latest work has revealed that there are several missing advanced prototype missiles from Halbech's stock. Mina can also train new recruits to the organization in firearms basics. Mina Tang becomes Michael Thorton's primary handler after the events of Operation Desert Spear. She will interact with Mike throughout most of his missions and will try to aid him in their goals of stopping Halbech from starting a global conflict for profit.

Omen Deng is a Taiwanese born national officer in the employ of the secret specialized paramilitary Chinese Secret Police as a high-ranking agent. He is a major figure and a person of interest in Taipei's intelligence community, and especially during the events of Alpha Protocol. He is the suspected assassin, thought to be working under orders of the Halbech Corporation, possibly manipulating the CSP, into assassinating Taiwanese President Ronald Sung in the 2010 conspiracy. Michael Thorton comes directly into contact with Deng in the Taiwanese capital during his mission to investigate the assassination plot and to foil any attempt at causing political unrest. Deng personally leads the Chinese Secret Police against Thorton and his efforts in Taipei, coming into conflict with him and his allies.

Scarlet Lake is an American freelance photojournalist featured in the game. She is known around the world, covering developments in dangerous places. is nearly immune to talk, reserving her respect for people who let their actions speak for themselves. She meets Michael Thorton immediately after the events of Operation Desert Spear on a flight out of Saudi Arabia. She becomes an ally, aiding him in exposing Halbech's wrongdoings by publishing the evidence he finds in the field.
Sergei Surkov is a character in the game Alpha Protocol. He is located within the embassy in Moscow and is the main objective of Michael Thorton in one of his missions.

is a mysterious mercenary character in the game, Alpha Protocol. Little is known about her except the fact that she was a former Stasi agent, taking part in numerous conflicts. was recruited into the East German Intelligence at a young age to be trained as an elite agent. She is the leader of the VCI branch in Moscow and a handler option in the Moscow and Rome hubs, as well as in the final operation as well. SIE meets Michael Thorton in Moscow during Operation Blood Feud, and can become a possible ally at various points in his operations.

Steven Heck is a contact and an ally based in Taipei. He is met and offers his aid in the Taiwanese capital, from which he also offers his services as a Clearinghouse contact dealing in illegal goods or services both inside and outside of Taipei.
is the president of Taiwan and a political figure that has been targeted for an assassination attempt during the Operation True Heirs in Taipei.

Yancy Westridge is the Chief of Operations of Alpha Protocol. He is a veteran of government service and secrecy as well as a skilled tactician. In the Graybox facility, Westridge is the only agent to hold any true rank above that of the other agents regardless of seniority. While newcomers and veteran agents hold no true power over one another regardless of the length of their service, Westridge holds general authority over the entire facility as Chief of Operations. Michael Thorton first encounters Westridge upon his first stay at the Graybox. Westridge welcomes him into the agency and introduces him to key on-site personnel and procedure. He also keeps facility personnel aware of present going-ons, including Thorton's entry into the agency and the most recent missile strike on Flight 6133 by Al-Samad, planned and ordered by Sheikh Ali Shaheed.
The Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) is an organization that does espionage work. The agents are encountered in Operation Deus Vult.
The Chinese Secret Police (CSP) is a faction featured in Alpha Protocol. They are the main antagonist faction in Operation True Heirs in Taipei, in which part of it is led by Omen Deng.
Jean Trouffant is one of the character present in SWAT 4. He is of French descent and is a notorious terrorist working for the Army of Faith. He was voiced by Michael Ralph.

Lawrence Fairfax was employed as a temporary carpenter at the City College construction site, and is currently the number one suspect in a string of grisly homicides. He appears to be a social recluse and living with his mother, Gladys Fairfax. He was voiced by Adam Arian.
Hadeon Koshka is a Ukrainian citizen. He is suspected of being the key member of a group of black market profiteers, selling old Soviet Union arms to American gangs. He was voiced by Nicholas Guest.

Gary Altman is the mechanic at the Victory Imports Auto Center. He first called 911 to report an attempted auto theft in his shop, and once the car thieves barricaded themselves in the auto center he was presumed to be trapped inside one of the shop's offices. He was voiced by Nick Guest.

Alice Jenkins is a drug addict and a repeat offender, currently on parole for a possession offence. She has been implicated in multiple robberies and has a history of resisting arrest. She is violent and unstable. She was voiced by Patricia Scanlon.

Allen Kruse is a mobster and appears almost daily at the Northside Vending and Amusements. He has been convicted of illegal possession of firearms and simple assault. He was arrested for racketeering, but not convicted. He was voiced by Fred Tatasciore.
Alex Jimenez, a.k.a. "The Knife", is a hitman connected to Columbian drug runners and wanted for several homicides. He was voiced by Armando Valdez – Kennedy.

Melinda Kline is a second year law student at the City College. She was reported missing on October 18, after the last known sighting at the end of her last classes at 7:45 pm on October 17. Her disappearance is both unexplained and out of character, according to her friends and family. She was voiced by Jenna Lamia.
Warren Rooney is the CEO of Red Library INC. He is described by coworkers as a stern but fair employer. He was voiced by Andy Milder.

Louie Baccus is the owner of Northside Vending and Amusements. Baccus has never been arrested, but is suspected to have ties to organized crime. Despite the mission briefing describes him as a possible suspect, he will always spawn as a civilian on the actual mission. He was voiced by Mike Starr.
Lawrence Adams is the general contractor in charge of the remodeling at the Old Granite Hotel. He was voiced by Mike Starr.

Gladys Fairfax is the mother of Lawrence Fairfax and the owner of their house at 25 Glendive Lane. She receives a disability pension from Social Security and is in generally bad health. She is very protective of her son despite the fact he is a suspected serial killer. She was voiced by Rhonda Gemignani.

Lian Niu is the owner of the Food Wall Restaurant, and he pays a manager to run it. He is under suspicion of dealing and modifying illegal firearms, and using his restaurant to launder his profits. He was voiced by Ron Yuan.
Simon Gowan is a mobster and a regular at the Northside Vending and Amusements. He is a dangerous felon that has been convicted of assault with a deadly weapon and robbery. He was voiced by Ron Yuan.

Ozzie Mandrill was a scheming, manipulative Australian land developer, and one of the primary antagonists of Escape from Monkey Island. He arrived in the Caribbean, hoping to build a corporate empire and wipe out piracy using the Ultimate Insult. His empire would've enabled him to connect various islands, including Booty Island, Melee Island and Jambalaya Island (possibly Lucre Island was also involved, where he was said to have intimidated local shopkeepers to work for him).

Carla, better known as the Sword Master of Mêlée Island, was a master swordsman and one of the pirates Guybrush Threepwood has to defeat to attain his status as a bonafide pirate. She was a fierce warrior and lived deep in the forest of the island in an attempt to avoid people from constantly challenging her title. Only the storekeeper in town knew where she hid, which allowed Guybrush to seek her out. She was initially trained by Captain Smirk, before her skills surpassed his. Her talent lay with her wit and an uncanny ability to think up original insults that few could ever challenge.

"Deadeye" Dave is the owner of the Palace o' Prostheses on Lucre Island, who makes his first and only appearance in Escape from Monkey Island. True to his nickname, Dave is blind in both eyes, and wears twin eyepatches. Despite his lack of sight, he has enhanced senses of hearing and smell, the latter of which he uses to identify his customers. Dave describes himself as "the Tri-Island Area's foremost expert in anatomical approximation", a claim which is not unfounded; he has a clientele list of at least 125 customers, and both stocks and makes all kinds of prosthetic parts in his shop, which he runs with assistance from his pet monkey, Pongo. At some point prior to Guybrush's arrival on Lucre Island, Pongo had abandoned his owner and made his way to Monkey Island, leaving Dave unable to operate his automated File-o-Matic filing system, which caused his regular customers distress. In addition, Dave had developed a cold which gave him a stuffy nose, and hampered him from detecting smells unless the odour had been amplified. Lucre's tourism boom seems to not have affected Dave's business at all, and not even Ozzie Mandrill had inquired about buying his store from him.

Esteban is a member of Elaine Marleys Crew, possibly the first mate. He was also present to assist Mrs. Marley Threepwood when she was running for Governor against Charles L. Charles. Marley gave him the responsibility of delivering the Deed to her mansion to the Town Hall to stop them from destroying it.

The Harbor Mistress appears as a minor character in Escape from Monkey Island. She works for the Inter-Island Transportation Services as a "Chief Assistant Shipyard Regulator, Harbor Operations, Melée Island". She will not lend a maritime vessel to anyone without proper authority. Eventually she lends Guybrush The Dainty Lady when he procures the The Mêlée Island Gubernatorial Symbol from Elaine.

Hellbeard the Unrepentant was once feared as one of the most dangerous pirates who ever lived and 'the scourge of the seven seas'. That was until he was cursed by the power of an Ultimate Insult. By the time Guybrush interacts with him, he is nothing more than the shell of a once feared pirate, often relying on his puppets to 'talk' in his stead. Since then he worked as a humble puppeteer on Knuttin Atoll. One of his most often performed shows featured puppets of Guybrush Threepwood and LeChuck. One handpuppet (Guybrush) is always rational and reasonable while the other (LeChuck) is violent, brutish by nature, and motivated by many pirate-y vices such as wenches and booty, uniquely reflecting Hellbeard's Ego and Id respectively. He was constantly nervous, shy and somewhat paranoid and barely able to remember his past as a fearsome corsair. On mention of The Ultimate Insult, he would become extremely frightened and attempt to hide. When Guybrush showed Hellbeard a depiction of The Ultimate Insult, he flees in absolute terror from the mere visage of the thing that cursed him to be who people see him as in the present day. His small puppet theatre on the beach doubled as his home.

Ignatius Cheese was the owner of the Scumm Bar in Escape from Monkey Island. He has a wife who seemed to be a stereotypical nagging wife, which made him immune to any nagging from anyone and therefore can't be persuaded that way. Mr. Cheese was one of few pirates who managed to hold his own against Ozzie Mandrill who have made several attempts of winning over the Scumm Bar. He joined Guybrush Threepwood's crew when he beat him in Insult Arm Wrestling. He claims himself to a skillful navigator, however he is also a bit of hotshot since sailed The Dainty Lady through a storm on the way to Lucre Island, a typhoon aroute Jambalaya Island and according to Otis sailing inbetween a pair of reefs. This has resulted in having to do repairs on the ship everytime Guybrush and his crew made port, while being watched by either Carla or Otis. Upon his return to Mêlée Island he found that his bar had been taken over by Ozzie Mandrill and reimagined as the Lua Bar. What happened to him after returning from Jambalaya Island is unknown.
Jojo Jr. is the Monkey Prince of Monkey Island.
Marco de Pollo is a character who makes his first and only appearance on Jambalaya Island during the events of Escape from Monkey Island.

Meathook is a resident on Hook Island, which was situated northeast the coast of Mêlée Island. He had two hooks instead of hands, because they were bitten off by a parrot which he named a "ferocious beast" when he was 30 years younger. He also lost an eye to the parrot. Though that parrot was long gone, he kept a smaller one called the Beast locked away in his home. He ran a hotel in his home on Hook Isle, though ironically, he did not like visitors. His attractions included animal acts, tattoo demonstrations and souvenirs. He was put out of business however when a guest was badly hurt by the Beast. He was a man of many talents. He was a ventriloquist and used his skill with the skull-shaped tattoo so that it appears to be talking. He named it Roger. Later he put Guybrush Threepwood to touch the Beast in order to agree to join his crew on the Sea Monkey in order to sail ot Monkey Island and save Governor Elaine Marley from LeChuck. He wrote two cookbooks called Breakfast at Meathook's and Afternoon at Meathook's. Guybrush called the first "a pretty useless book" and the latter "fascinating". Later in life, he took up painting portraits.

Otis is a local thief, who was known to have very bad case of halitosis. He tended to whine a lot, and would often bemoan his predicament. This tended to test the patience of those around him, especially considering his oral condition. He was seemingly of Spanish in origin, sporting a full beard. Later versions of Monkey Island gave him a unique accent.

Pegnose Pete was an infamous pirate on Lucre Island who lived in a shack in the islands swamp. Pete was named for having a prosthetic nose. He lost his real nose to a duck causing him to have a fear of the ducks ever since. He once had a run in with Freddie, the walking stick maker, but since he had with him a walking stick with a duck shaped handle Pete was frightened off. However Freddie was not convinced about the duck story having said he would have to be still for a long period of time to have his nose completely bitten off by a toothless duck. He bought his noses from the prostheses store in town. Since the owner was blind he could only tell Pete by his odorous smell. He had an account there under an alias so he could not be discovered, but have his noses replaced when he needed them. He framed Guybrush Threepwood for robbing the bank in order to take the Marley Heirlooms by impersonating Threepwood in a cheap mask. He had been hired to do so by Ozzie Mandrill. He placed the Heirlooms in his cave, but even when Threepwood captured him he did not give out the location. Mandrill eventually led Threepwood to it inadvertently. His impenetrable cave which could only be accessed underwater was very curious as it had a parlor he used to view on the treasure he had in it. Threepwood used his knowledge of Pete's anatidaephobia to scare him out of his home and into a trap. After he was captured the fake nose found in the bank eventually proved his guilt and Threepwood was cleared

Reverend Allegro Rasputin was the undead priest of The First Church of LeChuck. Allegro considered his religion similar to most others, except with 'more fire, screaming and pointy sticks'. He said that the evil one of his religion was the 'Anti-LeChuck' or He-Whose-Name-Must-Not-Be-Spoken who has the number 1138 tattooed on his head. It was obvious that he was referring to Guybrush Threepwood when he spoke of this, despite the errors in detail

Corporal Damon S. Baird (COG Tags CSID: 06059-81111-96) is a Gear of the Coalition of Ordered Governments Army and an expert in several technical, mechanical, and scientific fields. He also appears to be an expert in collecting and analyzing Locust weapons, other equipment, artifacts and documents. He joined the COG Army on Emergence Day, and soon after met Augustus Cole, who became his best friend. Fourteen years later, he was a member of Alpha Squad during the Lightmass Offensive, but joined Delta Squad along with Cole after the rest of the squad was killed. After the successful conclusion to the offensive, he was assigned to lead Sigma-One with Cole, taking part in several battles against the Locust. During Operation: Hollow Storm, he once again rejoined Delta, and fought through the campaign to sink Jacinto. He joined the rest of the COG in its evacuation to Port Farrall and later Vectes, where the COG was forced to deal with the Stranded Insurgency, and later the Lambent Pandemic, during which Baird was often on the front lines helping formulate plans with the rest of Delta and Command. When the COG collapsed, Baird joined the rest of Delta aboard the CNV Sovereign as part of the rapid response force that would assist several settlements the remnants of the COG had set up on the mainland.

Cadet Sofia Hendrik was a Gear soldier in the Coalition of Ordered Governments Army who served in Kilo Squad. During the Pendulum Wars, Sofia was a journalist, but joined the army after Emergence Day and was sent to the Halvo Bay Military Academy in Halvo Bay where she became a cadet in the Onyx Guard. When the Locust assaulted Halvo Bay, Sofia was assigned to Kilo Squad to keep an eye on Garron Paduk. She alongside Kilo Squad helped defeat General Karn by disobeying orders and she left the COG to travel with Paduk. They led a group of former COG and Union of Independent Republics soldiers and civilians who lived in Halvo Bay, but she was kidnapped by former members of the COG at an unknown point, leaving her fate unknown.

Chief Garron Paduk was a Private in the Coalition of Ordered Governments Army and a member of Kilo Squad. During the Pendulum Wars, he served as a Major in the Union of Independent Republics Infantry in his homeland of Gorasnaya. After the Locust assault on Gorasnaya, Paduk and some of his fellow Gorasni were rescued by the COG naval forces and he joined them to take revenge upon the Locust Horde, but also as a means of getting himself out of prison, as Gorasnaya refused to surrender to the COG after the Pendulum Wars.

Myrrah, also known as Subject EV-184-9, was co-creator of the Locust, and Queen of the Horde from c. 30 B.E. until her death in 17 A.E. Born to a Tyran Imulsion miner with a unique genetic reaction to Imulsion exposure, Myrrah was brought to the New Hope Research Facility where they treated children afflicted with Rustlung and other birth defects caused by Imulsion. Doctor Niles Samson performed experiments by mutating the children with Imulsion and Hollow creature DNA into human-animal chimeras called "Sires." After New Hope was shutdown by the COG, key subjects and staff were relocated to an underground laboratory in Mount Kadar by a fringe political group. Through further genetic experiments by Samson, Myrrah's embryonic stem cells and Sire DNA were hybridized to create the Locust. A Hivemind was established in the Locust, controlled only by Myrrah, making her their Queen. In adolescence, she began a relationship with Dr. Torres and had their daughter Reyna. When Torres escaped the facility with Reyna, Niles lied to Myrrah that her infant daughter was killed. Distraught, Myrrah led the Locust to slaughter all the scientists, including Niles, and established themselves as an independent race. As Queen, Myrrah led her people underground in the Hollow to create Nexus. As the Horde grew, they created their own religion, army, and science division. The leaders of each respective branch convened with Myrrah in the Locust Council. In the following years, the effects of Imulsion b

Sergeant Alexandra "Alex" Brand was one of the few female Gears serving in a frontline role in the post-Emergence Day Coalition of Ordered Governments army. She had been part of Chairman Richard Prescotts birthing program to boost the human population, but was unable to bear children, thus forcing her to take a combat role. She was assigned to Foxtrot four months after the Lightmass Offensive, and was reassigned to Delta-One on their reconnaissance of Jilane, since she was from the breeding farms located there. Alex later fought in several battles during the Lambent Pandemic.
Hendrix is the deuteragonist of Red Faction a former Ultor technician and secretly a member of Red Faction.
Eos is the tritagonist of Red Faction and the leader and founder of the Red Faction in 2075. Due to her acts against the Ultor Corporation, a sector in the Tharsis region is named after her.

Richard P. Gryphon was the deputy chief administrator of the Ultor Corporation on Mars when the First Martian Revolution struck. Gryphon is promoted to his position after the previous Administrator became a subject in the experiments of Ultor's head scientist, Axel Capek and is quickly intimidated into following his line. Despite his position second in seniority in the Ultor chain-of-command on Mars, he holds little sway over Colonel Masako and most definitely isn't using his power around Capek. He is glad to give himself up to Parker, a member of the Red Faction rebels, looking for any chance to escape the tricky position he is in, but Parker isn't quite so glad to have him along. After the Battle at the Ultor Waste Processing Facility, Parker hands Gyphon over to Orion for questioning about Capek and the Mutant Plague.

Nick Ramos ( born from 1996 to 2003) is the playable protagonist of Dead Rising 3. Nick is a mechanic who works for Wrench-O-Rama in the fictional city of Los Perdidos. He was an orphan and has no recollection of his early childhood years. He has a mysterious, unknown past. One of the few things he remembers was that he always had a tattoo of the number 12 on the right side of his neck. He, along with other survivors, seeks a means to escape Los Perdidos before it is firebombed by the military. Nick travels with his boss and owner of Wrench-O-Rama, Rhonda Kreske, and truck driver Dick Baker throughout the city in a combined effort to escape Los Perdidos within the six-day time limit, before the bombing announced by Secretary of Defense John Hemlock is set to occur. During the course of the game, it is discovered that Nick is naturally immune or resistant to the zombie infection, as shown by a bite wound healing instead of festering. As the youngest Dead Rising protagonist so far, Nick grows as a person as the story develops. Coming off as a naïve and somewhat cowardly young man, who has difficulties formulating plans in the beginning stages of the outbreak. His intentions, however, are always good: often putting other people's thoughts and needs before his own. Nick begins to develop a sense of purpose as he fights for survival, and the trying times during recent events in Los Perdidos have brought him. Unlike Chuck Greene, Nick has the ability to make combo weapons on the sp

Rhonda Kreske is a main character in Dead Rising 3. She is Nick Ramos' boss and owns the Wrench-O-Rama auto shop in Ingleton, where they both work. She is an excellent mechanic who has a "do or die" attitude. She is strong, both physically and mentally, and acts as a supporting role towards Nick. She often calls Nick "honey" or "sweetie" and even calls him "her sweet boy" at one point. She considers Nick family, and the two seem to have a strong mother-son bond. She is travelling with Ramos and Dick Baker in an attempt to escape the city. She works hard to attempt to fix the airplane that will get the group out of Los Perdidos. She later starts a search to find her ex-husband and is met with an unfortunate fate when she loses her left arm.

Gary Finkel is a supporting character and reformed antagonist in Dead Rising 3. He is a Los Perdidos-based mob enforcer working for an enigmatic mob boss at the Diamond Panty club and bar in Ingleton. Although he is somewhat helpful to Nick during their first encounter, he has an antagonistic role as he attempts to achieve the mission given to him by his boss throughout the main story. He is a former professional wrestler and the estranged ex-husband of Rhonda Kreske. He states that he used to live in a big house and had lots of money, although the circumstances of why he fell from grace and became a gangster are unknown.

Dick Baker is a character in Dead Rising 3. When joining a co-op game, the player will control Dick and play alongside Nick Ramos. Unlike any other character in the past (except for Frank in Case West), he also makes an appearance throughout the game's main story, even when you are not playing co-op. He's a truck driver who stops in Los Perdidos and gets trapped there, due to the current outbreak happening at the time. He travels alongside Nick Ramos, Annie, and Rhonda Kreske.

Isabela Keyes (born 1979) is the secondary antagonist turned deuteragonist of Dead Rising, the tritagonist of Dead Rising 2: Case West, and a major character in Dead Rising 3. She is also mentioned, but does not make an appearance, in Dead Rising 2. Isabela is the younger sister of Carlito Keyes, the mastermind behind the Willamette Incident during the events of Dead Rising. She helps her brother infect the population of Willamette as an act of vengeance for the destruction of Santa Cabeza. After seeing what her actions have caused, she has a change of heart and helps Frank West stop her brother from infecting the entire country. She also creates the first zombie inhibitor using Queens to slow the zombification process. This idea was used by Phenotrans to market Zombrex. She is working for Phenotrans, trying to develop a cure for the zombie pandemic during the events of Dead Rising 2: Case West, when she acts as Frank's source. Her whereabouts remain unknown after the explosion at the Phenotrans Facility at the end of Case West until she resurfaces ten years later in Dead Rising 3. She is searching for Nick Ramos to use his blood to create a permanent cure for zombification in hopes that it will clear her family's name.

Diego Martinez is a character in Dead Rising 3. He has been Nick Ramos' best friend since childhood, and the two have been to many different foster homes together throughout their childhood. He is an orphan with the number "49" tattooed on the back of his neck. He was in Los Perdidos during the time of the outbreak, protecting President Sonya Paddock. He also serves as a Psychopath in the Defeat Diego story mission.

Ronald "Red" Jackson is a character who is later revealed as the hidden tertiary antagonist in Dead Rising 3. He is a survivor in Los Perdidos and Annie's ex-boyfriend. Red leads and protects a band of infected survivors through the city. Like other Illegals, he too is infected and refuses to comply with the government's microchip requirement. Nick Ramos works alongside Annie and Red throughout much of the main story.
, also known as the Black Hammer, is a character featured in Darksiders and Darksiders III.

The Lord of the Hollows is a powerful entity that Fury encounters within the Hollows during her quest to destroy the Seven Deadly Sins. Wielding power enabling both weary Angels and Demons complete release from the cycle of life, death and rebirth of the Well of Souls, the Hollow Lord aids Fury but his own goals remain unknown.

Envy, also known as Resentment Made Flesh, then Covetous Queen, is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins that were originally imprisoned by the Four Horseman many centuries before the Apocalypse. However, upon the End War's premature onset and the destruction of Humanity, Envy, along with her brethren, were freed by the council and began to ravage the Earth and threaten the Balance. In the game, Envy is later revealed to be the main antagonist having faked her defeat, and is both the first and later the eleventh/final boss of Darksiders 3.

Abraxis was a respected emissary of the The Destroyer. On Earth, his task was gathering demonic powers in the Scar and overseeing the construction of the Black Throne. The Lord of the Hollows tasked Fury with killing Abraxis and bringing his soul to him to be hollowed. Fury has the choice of either killing Abraxis or The Lord of the Hollows.

is an entity featured in Darksiders. Its responsibility is to maintain balance and order in the universe by preventing any one celestial power from becoming too great. However, over time the council itself has become corrupted.
Mynce is the deuteragonist of BloodRayne. She was a dhampir who served as Rayne's mentor and friend.

Ryo Hazuki (Kanji: 芭月 涼, Rōmaji: Hazuki Ryō) is the main protagonist of the Shenmue series. He is an 18-year-old Japanese teenager who lives in Yamanose, Yokosuka, Japan. His mother, Akane Hazuki died of an illness when he was three years old. Ryo has been taught martial arts by his father, Iwao Hazuki, since he was seven. After his father was killed by Lan Di and the Dragon Mirror was stolen, Ryo swears vengeance for his father and goes on a journey throughout his hometown and China.

Nozomi Harasaki (Kanji: 原崎 望, Rōmaji: Harasaki Nozomi) is a young woman who, during the first Shenmue, is living in Yokosuka, Japan. She is the first love interest of Ryo Hazuki and his close friend and classmate. She has a crush on him, although Ryo has more mixed feelings.
Iwao Hazuki (Kanji: 芭月 巌, Rōmaji: Hazuki Iwao) was the father of Ryo Hazuki and the owner of the Hazuki Dojo.

Ine Hayata (Kanji: 早田 稲, Rōmaji: Hayata Ine), more commonly known as Ine-san (稲さん Ine-san), is the live-in housekeeper at the Hazuki Residence where she takes care of the basic running of the house. Ine is the mother-figure of Ryo Hazuki where she has known him ever since he was three years old.

Masayuki Fukuhara (Kanji: 福原 正幸, Rōmaji: Fukuhara Masayuki) or Fuku-san (福さん Fuku-san) as he is more commonly referred to by Ryo Hazuki, is a live-in student at the Hazuki Residence where he learned Martial Arts from Iwao Hazuki. Iwao took care of Masayuki since he was 15 years old.

Yaowen Chen (Hànzì: 陳 躍文, Pinyin: Chén Yuèwén, On'yomi: Chin Yōbun), or Master Chen (Hànzì: 陳大人, Pinyin: Chén-dàrén, On'yomi: Chin-taijin), is one of a few wealthy Chinese magnates living abroad in Japan, and he’s a big name in the trading business. He owns numerous trading operations worldwide, including the one in Yokosuka. Master Chen is an instrumental figure in helping Ryo Hazuki piece together the clues he needs, and assists him in getting to Hong Kong in the game Shenmue.

Guizhang Chen (Hànzì: 陳 貴章, Pinyin: Chén Guì Zhāng, On'yomi: Chin Kishō) is the son of Yaowen Chen (Master Chen). He is first featured in the first Shenmue game, where he is being trained by his father in both his trading business and the Yanqingquan, a martial art handed down over multiple generations in their family. He and Joy are also good friends, as seen in Shenmue Side Story.

Chai (チャイ Chai) is a low ranking member of the Chi You Men who stalks Ryo Hazuki and learns of the existence of the Phoenix Mirror. He is a central antagonist in the first Shenmue game and is the final boss of the game. He also is an antagonist in the game Shenmue III. He seems eager to impress Lan Di and work for him, so makes it his goal to steal the Phoenix Mirror from Ryo so that he can pass it on to Lan Di. He also becomes involved with Terry Ryan and the Mad Angels to further his goals.

Tom Johnson (トム・ジョンソン Tomu Jonson) is the owner of Tom's Hot Dogs which is located in both Dobuita and the New Yokosuka Harbor District. He dances by his hot dog truck, hoping that it will attract more customers. He is also a good friend of Ryo Hazuki.
Mark Kimberly (マーク・キンバリー Māku Kinbarī) is a worker at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.

Smith Bradley (スミス・ブラッドリー Sumisu Buraddorī ) is an American sailor from Colorado who works at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. He is a member of a gang of foreign sailors.

Terry Ryan (テリー・ライアン Terī Raian), also known as Terry of Yokosuka is the leader of the Mad Angels, a street gang based in the New Yokosuka Harbor District. He is a central antagonist in the first Shenmue. Cold, cruel and ultimately ruthless, Terry's sole ambition is to expand the criminal enterprises of the Mad Angels and bring them to the forefront of the Japanese underworld. He uses his expansive criminal network to track down the location of Iwao Hazuki and is instrumental in assisting Lan Di (and by greater association Chi You Men) retrieve the Dragon Mirror. By working with the Chi You Men, Terry hopes to gain control of Yokosuka and expand the influence of the Mad Angels overseas while also eliminating any opposition to the gang.
Keizo Oishi (Kanji: 大石 敬三, Rōmaji: Ōishi Keizō) is the owner of Bunkado Antiques in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. He is also the grandfather of Ryoko Nishizawa.

Xiuyu Xia (Hànzì: 夏 秀玉, Pinyin: Xià Xiù Yù, On'yomi: Ka Shūgyoku) is the owner of Russiya China Shop in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. She is also Gaowen Xia's grandmother, an acquaintance of Kame Shibukawa and Guangji Wang's teacher.

Megumi Mishima (三島 恵 Mishima Megumi) is a kindergarten student who lives in Sakuragaoka, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. She is the youngest daughter of Fusayo Mishima and Takanobu Mishima and the younger sister of Mayumi Mishima.
Kayoko Ito (伊藤佳代子 Ito Kayoko) is a first grade elementary school student and the younger sister of Naoyuki Ito and Yasuo Ito. She lives in Sakuragaoka, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Tao Duo Ji (Hànzì: 陶 多吉, Pinyin: Táo Duō Jí, On'yomi: Tō Takichi) is the owner of the Ajiichi Chinese Restaurant in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. He is the husband of Tao Lin Xia.
Tao Lin Xia (Hànzì: 陶林夏 Pinyin: Táo Línxià, On'yomi: Tō Rinka) is a chef and waitress at the Ajiichi Chinese Restaurant in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. She is the wife of Tao Duo Ji.
Guangji Wang (Hànzì: 王 高基, Pinyin: Wáng Gāojī, On'yomi: Wan Kōki) is an apprentice working at Ajiichi Chinese Restaurant in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.

Eri Tajima (田嶋 絵梨 Tajima Eri) is a high school student who appears in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. She is good friends with Nozomi Harasaki and Noriko Nakamura. She is also the sister of Hideki Tajima.
Noriko Nakamura (中村紀子 Nakamura Noriko) is a high school student who visits Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Ichiro Sakurada (桜田 伊知郎 Sakurada Ichirō) is a friend and classmate of Ryo Hazuki and Naoyuki Ito in the game Shenmue.

Hisaka Sawano (沢野ひさか Sawano Hisaka) is the manager of Hokuhoku Lunches at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. She is the first daughter of Kinuyo Sawano and the older sister of Mai Sawano.
Takashi Takashiro (高城 隆史 Takashiro Takashi) is the owner of his own Tattoo Parlor located at Okayama Heights in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Etsuko Sekine (関根 エツ子 Sekine Etsuko) is an employee at the Asia Travel Company in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Yuriko Kikuchi (Kanji: 菊池 優理子, Rōmaji: Kikuchi Yuriko) is an employee at Smiley Flower Shop in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Tetsuya Nagashima (長島 哲也 Nagashima Tetsuya) is a high school delinquent who can often be seen with Akio Enoki around Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Noriyuki Tsuruoka (鶴岡 紀之 Tsuruoka Noriyuki) is the manager of Jupitor's Jackets in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Yoshie Aoi (青井良江 Aoi Yoshie) assists her husband Masaru Aoi in running the Yaokatsu Produce store located in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Susumu Aketagawa (明田 川進 Aketagawa Susumu) is the manager of Yamaji Soba Noodles in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.

Mayumi Mishima (Kanji: 三島まゆみ, Rōmaji: Mishima Mayumi) is a childhood friend and classmate of Ryo Hazuki from kindergarten to junior high school. She lives in Sakuragaoka, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue. She is also the oldest daughter of Fusayo Mishima and Takanobu Mishima and the older sister of Megumi Mishima.
Setsu Abe (Kanji: 阿部 節, Rōmaji: Abe Setsu) is an elderly woman who is the owner of the Abe Store located in Sakuragaoka, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Ryuji Tatsumi (辰己 竜次 Tatsumi Ryūji) works at the Water Dragon Thrift Store in Dobuita,, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.

Gaowen Xia (Hànzì: 夏 高文, Pinyin: Xià Gāo Wén, On'yomi: Ka Kōbun) is a third-generation Chinese who is the grandson of Xiuyu Xia, the owner of the Russiya China Shop in Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Hitoshi Numakubo (沼久 保仁 Numakubo Hitoshi) is a forklift operator at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Kiyoshi Yamanaka (山中 潔 Yamanaka Kiyoshi) is an employee at Yamaji Soba Noodles in Dobuita, Yokosuka in the game Shenmue. He lives in Sakuragaoka.
Bob Dickson (ボブ·ディクソン Bobu Dikuson) is an American sailor from Idaho who works at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Robert Wells (ロバート·ウェルズ Robāto U~Eruzu) is a Mexican sailor currently working on the same ship as Harry Thompson at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.

Harry Thompson (ハリー・トンプソン Harī Tonpuson) is an American sailor from Texas and the leader of a gang of foreign sailors who work at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Jones Henders (ジョーンズ・ヘンダース Jōnzu Hendāsu) is a member of a gang of foreign sailors and a worker at the New Yokosuka Harbor District, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Honey Jackson (ハニー・ジャクソン Hanī Jakuson) is Tom Johnson's girlfriend. She helps Tom run his hot dog stand in Dobuita and the New Yokosuka Harbor District in Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Lidia Bennett (リディア・ベネット Ridia Benetto) is a foreigner who can be seen wandering the streets of Dobuita, Yokosuka, Japan in the game Shenmue.
Forge is a gamemode in Halo 3, Halo: Reach, Halo 4, Halo 2: Anniversary, Halo 5: Guardians, and Halo Infinite. It allows for both playing and editing multiplayer maps.
Serina (SN: SNA 1292-4), was a second generation AI construct assigned to the , a modified . Serina was a military advisory smart AI.

Lendel is one of the characters in the game Pyre. He first appears at the Ridge of Gol. He is the cold-mannered head of the exile triumvirate you encountered at the Ridge of Gol. He leads the Accusers and he harbors ill will for something he thinks you did.
Falcon Ron runs the Slugmarket in the game Pyre. He is a traveling sales-creature and proprietor of the Downside Slugmarket.
Almer Oldheart is one of the characters in the game Pyre. He is a member of the Fate, a triumvirate in purple. He is also known as Almer the Helpless.
Ti'zo is one of the characters in Pyre. He is a Drive-Imp who eventually joins the Nightwings.
Tariq, The Lone Minstrel is a bard who accompanies the Nightwings in their journey. He carries the White Lute with him, wherever he goes.
Big Bertrude is one of the characters in Pyre.
Sir Gilman is an exile and a member of the Nightwings triumvirate. The principled Wyrm is first met as a member of the Pyrehearts before defecting to join your group.
Sir Deluge is the cowardly leader of the Pyrehearts.
Volfred Sandalwood is one of the characters in the game Pyre.

Lumina is a major antagonist in Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII. She resembles Serah Farron in appearance and crosses paths with Lightning during her quest to save the world, at times appearing as a friend and other times as an adversary.

personnages.description: , known as Nella for short, is a character appearing in Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom. She is Evan's governess who has watched over him since he was a child, and taught him everything about magic and fighting. She was admired by many. She was killed by the Black Knight, protecting Evan by holding off the latter long enough to escape as he and Roland were escaping Ding Dong Well through jumping off a bridge. Before she died, she implored Evan to be strong for the kingdom of Ding Dong Dell. Her corpse is then found by her fellow handmaidens. As Evan's kingdom Evermore grows, he names the town square "Aranella's Square".

personnages.description: King Leonhard Tildrum (ラウズオ "Rauzeo") was the King of Ding Dong Dell for over a generation and was the father of Evan Pettiwhisker Tildrum. He was a compassionate ruler and worked toward his goal of uniting two races that have been feuding for generations on end. It was the feud between The Grimalkin and Mousekind that was the center of the problem in Ding Dong Dell, and was the direct cause of the death of the beloved King Leonhard as well as the coup that overthrew his young son, Evan. King Leonhard had a trusted advisor named Mausinger. Mausinger was Leonhard's chief counsul and was directly linked with leading the coup and spearheading the assassination of Leonhard. Mausinger believed that he was simply being played by Leonhard and that none of his intentions were just not true. King Leonhard was a very respected king, even by some of the mouse folk.

personnages.description: In Dragon Quest XI, Luminary is the honorific title of a person selected by the World Tree Yggdrasil to become her champion warrior in times of greatest need. When a Luminary is born into the world of Erdrea, his or her leaf blooms in a burst of light that sets the skies aglow. The child is also given Yggdrasil's Mark, from which divine power can be summoned to aid him or her in accordance with Yggdrasil's will. As the story begins, only two men have borne the title: Erdwin, known as the Luminary of Legend, and the present-day Prince of Dundrasil.

personnages.description: Trevor Christopher Belmont (known in Japan as ) is a member of the ancestral Belmont Clan of vampire hunters who lived during the 15th century. He was introduced in the Castlevania series as the main protagonist of the 1989 game Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse; reprising this role in the Pachislot Akumajō Dracula subseries. Because he and his relatives were feared by the people for their supernatural powers, the Belmont Clan lived outside of society. Trevor is renowned for being the first man who defeated Count Dracula. Trevor has also made many appearances in other installments of the series, as well as other related productions, often appearing as a supporting character, or as an alternate version of himself in a different continuity, or simply making a cameo. He plays a supportive narrative role in Castlevania: Curse of Darkness and its manga adaptation, and even has his own mode in the former, where he becomes a playable character with his own adventure and unique moveset.

Victor Belmont is the alternative protagonist of the canceled Sega Dreamcast game Castlevania: Resurrection. He escaped his destiny of facing Count Dracula in 19th Century England. However, when Dracula's Castle appears in the year 1666, he is transported to that time and is taken under Sonia Belmont's wing (also time-displaced) and faces Count Dracula.

Second Acolyte is a music theme composed by Óscar Araujo for Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2. Though it is used for occasional foreboding ambiance in the game, it is notoriously identified as the background theme that plays when Dracula is being stalked by a vengeful Agreus in the Greenhouse's labyrinth.
Euryale, Stheno and Medusa are the Gorgon Sisters and they appear in Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2. The three merged and created the Gorgon titan.
Euryale, Stheno and Medusa are the Gorgon Sisters and they appear in Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2. The three merged and created the Gorgon titan.
Agreus is a character in Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2. He is one of the Old Gods and Pan's brother. He appears as one of the game's antagonists.

The Toy Maker is an indirect antagonist in Castlevania: Lords of Shadow - Mirror of Fate, through his many creations and innovations of death, as well as a supporting character in Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2. Although he is never actually seen until near the very end of Mirror of Fate, he makes a very prominent appearance in Lords of Shadow 2, complete with some backstory explained to the player before he becomes a direct antagonist and attacks them in a bizarre boss fight.

Goh Hamazaki (, Hamazaki Gō) is a character featured as an antagonist in Yakuza 3/Yakuza Kiwami 3 and a supporting character in Yakuza 4. Originally the patriarch of the Yokohama-based Hamazaki Family and a lieutenant of the Tojo Clan, he earned the moniker "The Emperor of Hama" (, Hama no Teiō), with "Hama" referring to Yokohama.
Molstrom is the captain of The Pirates and the main antagonist in Owlboy.

Victoria von Bathysphere is a recurring character in the LittleBigPlanet series. In LittleBigPlanet 2, Victoria is the Creator Curator of Victoria's Laboratory and a member of the Alliance. In LittleBigPlanet 3, she hosts the second term of Popit Puzzles. Victoria is also a main character in LittleBigPlanet 2: Move Pack: Rise of the Cakeling.

personnages.description: SpongeBob SquarePants (born , ) is the main protagonist of the animated series of the same name and . He was created and designed by the show's creator and former marine biologist, the late Stephen Hillenburg. Hillenburg based SpongeBob on Bob the Sponge, a character that he had created for his educational book, The Intertidal Zone in . SpongeBob is a childish, joyful, hardworking, silly, and a bubbly sea sponge who lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, in the underwater city of Bikini Bottom. He is best friends with his neighbor . He works as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, a job in which he is exceptionally skilled at and enjoys thoroughly. He attends Mrs. Puff's Boating School, and he dreams of receiving his boating license. Unfortunately, he tenses up whenever he drives a boatmobile and drives recklessly by speeding or crashing, which causes him to fail Mrs. Puff's exam every time. One of the series' rules is that SpongeBob can never permanently receive his boating license in order to keep Mrs. Puff as a main character in the series. SpongeBob appears in nearly every episode of the series, beginning with the series' debut episode, "Help Wanted." He is voiced by Tom Kenny, who is married to the voice of Karen, Jill Talley.

Nyx Avatar is the final boss of Persona 3 (or just The Journey for Persona 3 FES). It is an avatar of Nyx, empowered by Erebus, who serves as the final sign for the Fall, or the end of the world. It is fought on the top of Tartarus during the ninth Full Moon Operation on January 31.

Isako Toriumi is a non-player character in Persona 3. She is a faculty member of Gekkoukan High School and teaches composition.

Mr. Ekoda is the homeroom adviser in class 2-E at Gekkoukan High School. He teaches Classic Literature.

The protagonist of Persona 3, canonically known as Makoto Yuki (having been used in other media and later confirmed as the default name in the 2023 re-release of Persona 3 Portable), is a transfer student enrolling in Gekkoukan High School in Iwatodai City. He is an orphan whose parents died on the Moonlight Bridge in their car during a fatal incident a decade prior to the game. In Persona 3 Portable, he has a female counterpart.

First appearing in Soul Edge, she returned in Soulcalibur, Soulcalibur II, Soulcalibur III, Soulcalibur IV, Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny, Soulcalibur: Unbreakable Soul, Soulcalibur: Lost Swords & Soulcalibur VI.

Chen (simplified Chinese: 陈, traditional Chinese: 陳, pinyin: Chén) is a non-playable character first seen in Dead or Alive 3. He is Brad Wong's old drunken master and great teacher of zui quan. He sent Brad to search for a wine named "Genra", which turned into a three to four-year long quest. He isn't seen again after his short appearance but he is mentioned in Dead or Alive 4 when Brad is talking to Eliot. During this conversation, Brad describes Chen as "your average drunk". Despite this fact, Brad still turned out to be a great fighter.

Basil arrived in E.D.N. III ten years before the Green Eye attack and death of Gale. Gale saved Basil from danger and like Wayne, he gave Basil a harmonizer although being a different type from Wayne's harmonizer. She managed to survive for thirty years after the death of Gale, she first encounters Wayne in a VS duel. After the fight ends, she leaves. She sacrifices herself to help Wayne by stopping the advancing NEVEC soldiers by detonating a wave of placed bombs.

personnages.description: Miranda was formerly a nurse who ultimately became a castaway at the alternate dimension of Dite. She had formerly worked at the Dhekelia SBA Memorial Hospital in Cyprus. However, during a routine drive, the comms at the hospital went offline, so she and a fellow doctor drove back to the hospital. Upon arrival, she discovered that the hospital was on fire. Shortly afterwards, however, their ambulance got sucked into a wormhole into Dite, with the doctor succumbing to the Death Dust and becoming a Wanderer, she ultimately was passed out, ultimately being rescued by the Captain (who had arrived at the location to investigate a chopper crash they had witnessed earlier). After explaining how she got there, she also told Reeve to take off his shirt because she needed to inspect him due to his injured status. She also voiced a desire to cure the Wanderers, although Reeve strongly suggested against it. Miranda had been to a lot of conflict regions as a nurse, treating wounded soldiers. She also owned pets and expressed concern for their well-being while at Dite.

A Korean swordsman, Hwang made his first appearance in Soul Edge, and has returned for Soulcalibur and Soulcalibur III. Prior to Soulcalibur III, his name was written as Hwang Sung Kyung. He later returned in Soulcalibur VI as a DLC character with a brand new costume and moveset.

Nathaniel William "Rock" Adams (ロック・アダムズ, Rokku Adamuzu, lit. "Rock Adams") is a fictional character in the Soul series of fighting games. He appears in Soul Edge, Soulcalibur, Soulcalibur III, Soulcalibur IV and Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny. He does not appear in Soulcalibur II, but the character Berserker has a similar moveset. In most games, Rock is a non-starting character who must be unlocked. His title in Soul Edge is "爆走する闘士" (Bakusou suru Toushi), which was translated as "Reckless Commando" in the PlayStation port of the game. His title in Soulcalibur is "激震の大地" (Gekishin no Daichi), which was translated as "The Earthshaker" in the Dreamcast port of the game, and "The trembling earth" in Legend of SOULCALIBUR. The title that he uses from Soulcalibur III to Soulcalibur Broken Destiny is "きの" (Takeki Yajū no Kiba), which was translated as the "Wild Beast's Fang" in Soulcalibur Broken Destiny and Soulcalibur VI. What lies in his soul is Resolution.

Captain Pud is a minor character of LittleBigPlanet 3. His age is not confirmed, and he is known to be the husband of Nana Pud and father of Newton.
Coach Rock is a character, and a challenge room host from Book 1: Manglewood.
Vera Oblonsky is a nonplayable character, inhabitant of The Ziggurat in LittleBigPlanet 3.

Larry Da Vinci is one of the most recurring characters in LittleBigPlanet. In LittleBigPlanet 2, he is the founder and leader of The Alliance and Creator Curator of Da Vinci's Hideout. Da Vinci re-appears in LittleBigPlanet 3 as a Popit Professor in the Popit Puzzles, where he teaches the player how to use the basic level-editing tools.

Dr. Maxim is a Quest Giver in LittleBigPlanet 3. He needs two Sackpeople to help with his Here and There Device. He is one of the characters that you can help with a quest in the level Here, There and Everywhere within the Ziggurat Grand Hall. To help on this quest, you would need to collect all the Prize Bubbles to collect the stickers.
El Jeff is one of the minor characters of Bunkum Lagoon. He is the person that hosts the Battle of the Airwaves challenge room.
Papal Mache is the Creator Curator of The Ziggurat.

Felicia was first introduced in Darkstalkers: The Night Warriors as one of two female characters alongside Morrigan Aensland. She has appeared in every game in the series and in numerous cross overs including Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes along with Morrigan, Baby Bonnie Hood and Anakaris. 
 
Felicia is a Catwoman who was taken in and raised by a Sister named Rose who gave her the name Felicia from the word Felicity. Despite her identity as a Darkstalker being exposed, she was not turned away by her as Felicia had feared. When Rose passed away, Felicia left her town hoping to be a musical star. 
 
She is an energetic and optimistic catgirl who enjoys singing, dancing and making friends with people. All she wishes for is peaceful coexistence with humans and doesn't resort to fighting unless she cannot avoid it. Because of this, she stands out among all the other Darkstalkers, many of whom are antihero at best. Her nice attitude has made some people tolerate Darkstalkers more and this gives her more motivation to persuade more humans to accept them since Felicia loves humans due to their personalities and open-mindedness, despite some not accepting Darkstalkers easily she doesn't give up her passion to make friends with the ones that care.
Gustavo is a challenge room host from Book 1: Manglewood. He hosts the challenge level The Wheel Deal.

The Head Fort Guard is a character in Manglewood in LittleBigPlanet 3. He is the head of the Fort Guards in the level High Stakes Heist, and orders commands to the others via a speaker. His body is never seen. He is voiced by Glenn Wrage.
Hildur is a challenge room host from Book 3: Bunkum Lagoon. She hosts the challenge level Joust in Time.
Marlon Random is the Creator Curator of Manglewood. Marlon has gone a bit crazy after Manglewood became a swamp, and is obsessed with movies and film.
Nana Pud is a character from LittleBigPlanet 3 thst lives in Stitchem Manor, Bunkum and is the guardian of the Titans. She is Newton's mother. She is the Creator Curator of Prologue.
Pinky Buflooms is the Creator Curator of the Bunkum Lagoon, who is a character in LittleBigPlanet 3. She refers to herself as the queen of Bunkum, and Protector of the Creative Heart.

Zom-Zom the Far-Out (pronounced Zoom Zoom) is an eccentric character who runs a travelling costume shop. He speaks in an unusual accent with potentially French inflections, despite his rather Arabian stylings.
Koji (, Kōji) is a recurring character in the Yakuza series introduced in Yakuza 3. He is a resident of Morning Glory Orphanage.

personnages.description: The French Narrator, nicknamed Frenchy, is a supporting character in the series. He is a deep-sea diver with a French accent. He introduces many episodes and reads time cards, narrating the show as if it were a nature documentary. The narrator is usually only heard as a voice, but he makes live-action appearances in the episodes "No Free Rides," "Feral Friends," "SpongeBob's Big Birthday Blowout," "Potato Puff," "Bizarro Bottom," all five episodes of the event The Tidal Zone, and "Sandy's Country Christmas." He is voiced by Tom Kenny, who also voices , , , and various other characters. In his rare on-screen appearances, he is physically portrayed by Dan Southworth and later Vincent Waller, with Tom Kenny still providing the voice.

personnages.description: Patrick Star (born ) is one of the ten main characters of the animated series , and the main protagonist of his own spin-off, . He is 's best friend as well as one of his two neighbors. He is an unintelligent and overweight pink sea star. He is voiced by Bill Fagerbakke and first appears in "Help Wanted." Patrick lives under a rock in the underwater city of Bikini Bottom. SpongeBob and are his two neighbors, and, when viewed on the front side, are to the right of his residence. A running gag in the franchise is that Patrick has crushes on mermaids, especially Princess Mindy. He and SpongeBob both tend to bother Squidward, though they do it unknowingly and have good intentions. In the original series, Patrick is the son of Herb and Margie Star and the brother of Sam Star. In The Patrick Star Show, Patrick has a different family: parents and , grandfather , and sister .

personnages.description: Sandra Jennifer Olivia "Sandy" Cheeks (born ) is one of the ten main characters in the franchise. She is an American squirrel from the surface who wears a diving suit and lives in an air-filled glass treedome to survive underwater. She is voiced by Carolyn Lawrence. Sandy is a thrill seeker who loves extreme sports and karate. Having come from the state of Texas, she has a Southern drawl and a love for rodeos. She works as a scientist and builds her treedome, air suit, and helmet herself. She is also a member of the Gal Pals along with , Mrs. Puff, and .

The Mermalair Computer directs to press all of the security override switches so she can help shut down the security system.

personnages.description: Sheldon J. Plankton, most commonly known as Plankton, is one of the ten main characters of the franchise. He is a planktonic copepod who runs the Chum Bucket restaurant alongside , a waterproof computer who is his sidekick and wife. The Chum Bucket is unpopular in Bikini Bottom because it serves , a type of bait made from fish meat. Plankton is the main antagonist of the franchise, as well as the protagonist of Plankton: The Movie, in which Karen takes the role of the main villainess. There are also many episodes in which Plankton acts as a sympathetic anti-hero. Plankton despises his eternal arch-rival, , for running a successful restaurant because the Chum Bucket rarely gets any customers. His main goal is to steal Krabs' secret formula for and run Mr. Krabs out of business. Karen gives him a variety of plans to steal it, but their efforts always end up failing in the process. Plankton is voiced by Mr. Lawrence, one of the show's writers. Both Plankton and Karen were promoted to main characters in the credits of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, which listed them in the "Main Cast" section. After the movie, they began to appear much more frequently. Plankton succeeds at stealing the formula in The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, but his goal of world domination is eventually thwarted by SpongeBob. personnages.description: Larry the Lobster is a recurring side character in . He is a muscular red lobster who, along with Scooter, is a common attendee of Goo Lagoon. He first appears in the episode "Ripped Pants." He is also the owner of his own gym. His voice is normally provided by Doug Lawrence in most of his speaking appearances. Bill Fagerbakke fills in for Larry the Lobster's voice during the Anchor Toss in "MuscleBob BuffPants" and a cameo in "House Hunting." He is one of six entities named "Larry" in the franchise, with the others being Larry Luciano, Larry the Snail, Larry SquarePants, Pinhead Larry, and Lucky Larry.

personnages.description: Squidward J. Quincy Tentacles (born ) is one of the ten main characters of the franchise. He is and 's grumpy next-door neighbor and the former's coworker at the Krusty Krab who lives in an Easter Island moai head. He is a mostly unpleasant artist and musician, and his favorite hobbies are painting self-portraits and playing the clarinet. Even though Squidward's name contains the word "squid," he is an octopus, not a squid, as confirmed in many interviews and episodes. In "Jeffy T's Prankwell Emporium," it is revealed that he was named that by his dad because he thought it was funny and used it as a prank. Squids have ten limbs, many more than Squidward has. The series' animators believed that giving him eight limbs would be too burdensome and difficult to animate, which is why he is usually depicted with six limbs. Notable exceptions are brief scenes in "Pressure" and "Sold!," in which he has a full set of eight legs. In "Feral Friends," his exact species is identified: a . He is a very cynical, selfish, sassy (as Patchy the Pirate stated in a deleted scene), introverted (as he stated himself), and a stick-in-the-mud individual. He works as the cashier at the Krusty Krab, a job he usually hates, due to SpongeBob's annoyance and ' cheapness. Squidward is frequently annoyed by SpongeBob's loud and cheerful behavior, but he sometimes sticks up for SpongeBob and sees him as a friend. He can also have a supportive side for his boss on occasion. Patrick also annoys him due to his

personnages.description: Penelope "Poppy" Puff, more commonly known as just Mrs. Puff, is one of the ten main characters in the franchise. She is 's teacher at Boating School, where she teaches students how to drive boats like underwater cars. She is a pufferfish who wears a sailor uniform. She is voiced by Mary Jo Catlett. Teaching and driving are her passions in life, being talented at both, and having taught every student other than SpongeBob how to drive. She and SpongeBob are always on an "endless quest" to get him a driver's license, but due to his reckless boating skills, they never succeed. Mrs. Puff's school is attached to a submerged lighthouse and surrounded by a stunt-driving course. Stephen Hillenburg called Mrs. Puff the "most important" character to the show's history, saying that she "saved" the show from not being greenlit. He created her as a new main character in 1997, shortly after he pitched SpongeBob to Nickelodeon. The network gave him an order that they wanted: they would only produce the show if SpongeBob was a kid who went to school. Hillenburg was ready to decide against working with Nickelodeon because writing SpongeBob as a school-age child went against his creative vision. However, he came up with Mrs. Puff and her Boating School as a compromise, allowing SpongeBob to attend school as an adult. Because Hillenburg began his career as a marine science teacher, Mrs. Puff was a personal character to him, and he channeled many of his experiences as a teacher into her characte

personnages.description: Eugene Harold Krabs (born , or , ), more commonly known as Mr. Krabs, is one of the ten main characters in the franchise. He is a miserly red crab who lives in an anchor with his daughter, , who is a teenage whale. He is the owner and founder of the Krusty Krab restaurant as well as the employer of both and . Mr. Krabs was designed by Stephen Hillenburg, a marine biology teacher. Hillenburg often received fan letters asking why Pearl is a whale while her father is a crab. Hillenburg simply wanted each member of the main cast to be a different animal. Mr. Krabs is obsessed with money and goes to great length to increase his wealth, to the point where he occasionally treats money better than his daughter and employees. Mr. Krabs' only business competition comes from the Chum Bucket, a failing restaurant run by his rival Sheldon Plankton and his wife . Plankton and Karen are constantly scheming to steal the Krabby Patty secret formula that makes the Krusty Krab so successful. Mr. Krabs is usually voiced by Clancy Brown and first appears in the episode "Help Wanted."

personnages.description: Ernie (or Jim) Huckler, commonly known by his superhero name Mermaid Man, is a semi-retired superhero who lives in Bikini Bottom. He and his sidekick Barnacle Boy are the stars of a show-within-a-show called The Adventures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy, but they are also real superheroes within the SpongeBob SquarePants universe. The two are now very old and currently reside at Shady Shoals Rest Home. However, their two biggest fans, and Patrick Star, convinced them to come out of retirement. He was voiced by the late Ernest Borgnine until his death in 2012, and his younger self was voiced by the late Adam West in "Back to the Past" and Tom Kenny in most other appearances.

personnages.description: Tim (or Kyle) Stangler, better known by his superhero name Barnacle Boy, is the sidekick of Mermaid Man. He is a superhero and a parody of both and . He is said to be 68 years old. He first appears in the episode "Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy." Barnacle Boy's voice actor, the late Tim Conway, passed away in . Along with Mermaid Man and Grandma SquarePants, he is one of the three supporting characters who have been retired from the series. He became retired from the series alongside Mermaid Man ever since the late Ernest Borgnine's death in . He and Mermaid Man now appear in non-speaking appearances or as toys. His younger self is voiced by Burt Ward.

personnages.description: King Neptune XIV is the overarching protagonist on . He and his wife, Queen Amphitrite, are the supreme rulers of the ocean. King Neptune's name is often used in place of God's, with phrases such as "Dear Neptune," "Thank Neptune," "Neptune's preserver!," and "Oh my Neptune." King Neptune is frequently mentioned by name, but his physical appearances are more sporadic. He first appears in person in "Neptune's Spatula," and he plays important roles in "The Clash of Triton," "Trident Trouble," and "High Sea Diving." In The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, Neptune appears with a different design from the TV series. The movie also introduces his daughter, Princess Mindy.

personnages.description: Lexaeus, the , is the Nobody of Aeleus, and Rank V of Organization XIII. He wields control over earth and uses his massive Skysplitter Axe Sword to create earthquakes and brutally slam opponents. Lexaeus appears in Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories and Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories during Riku's storyline, working with Zexion and Vexen to try and manipulate Riku into serving them. In contrast to his fighting style and physique, he is a disciplined schemer who tries to keep people such as Vexen in line. Lexaeus appears in Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days as a playable character in Mission Mode. Tetsuya Nomura said that Lexaeus "has slow movement, but has very high attack power".

Zexion, the , is the Nobody of Ienzo, and Rank VI of Organization XIII. He weaves illusions to fight for him. Unlike the other Organization members, Zexion's weapon was originally unknown, and his talents were used only outside of normal combat. In Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories, Zexion's weapon was revealed to be a book called a Lexicon. Zexion appeared in Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories as a participant in the struggle within the Organization between the newer and veteran members. He is also central to the plot to use Riku as a puppet in Castle Oblivion, though this ultimately backfires and indirectly leads to Zexion's own death. Zexion also appears in Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days, as one of the playable characters in Mission Mode.

"No mamby pamby Mudokon meat puppet is gonna make me look like a fool! We'll have that traitor Abe in no time. OR MY NAME AIN'T, uh...uh...uhh..." -General Dripik declaring martial law and forgetting his own name.General Dripik is the Glukkon in charge of the Slig Barracks and, after the disappearance of Molluck, one of three high ranking Glukkon executives with the authority to shut down the main security gates to SoulStorm Brewery. He is one of the three secondary antagonists (alongside Director Phleg and Vice President Aslik) of Abe's Exoddus.

Director Phleg is one of the high-ranking executives of the SoulStorm Brewery and the "head boner" of the Bonewerkz, a factory where excavated bones are processed into the raw ingredients for a variety of products, notably SoulStorm Brew. He is one of the three secondary antagonists (alongside General Dripik and Vice President Aslik) of Abe's Exoddus.

"Uncle Aslik's been take'n good care of ya right? I love all a ya like you was my own right? But if we don't catch this Abe guy its the brew vats for all a ya! Now, what are ya wait'n for? Get back ta work!" -Aslik addressing Mudokon workers in Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus. Vice President Aslik/CEO Ludwig von Aslik is the administrator of FeeCo Depot and is a high-ranking executive of the SoulStorm Brewery. He is one of the three secondary antagonists (alongside General Dripik and Director Phleg) of Abe's Exoddus and one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside Morguer) of Soulstorm.

The Brewmaster was the interim Head of Office for SoulStorm Brewery 401 in Abe's Exoddus, along with serving as full time head of Soulstorm Brewery and Projekt (sic) Soulstorm during the titular game. He is the secondary antagonist of the Oddworld series, as well as the main antagonist of Abe's Exoddus and Soulstorm.

personnages.description: is a major antagonist in the Dragon Ball franchise. He is the descendant of Chilled, the younger son of King Cold, the younger brother of Cooler and the father of Kuriza. Inheriting his father's imperialist army and rising to power as the emperor of Universe 7 at a young age, Frieza quickly established himself as a ruthless tyrant, feared across the universe for his unparalleled cruelty and power. Ever since his invasion of Namek, Frieza has been the series' most recurring villain, clashing with his archnemesis Goku and his allies on several occasions, becoming even more powerful every time. Frieza is primarily responsible for the Genocide of the Saiyans and serves as the main antagonist of the overarching Frieza and Golden Frieza Sagas, as well as a villainous protagonist during the Universe Survival Saga.

personnages.description: , born , is a Saiyan raised on Earth and the main protagonist of the Dragon Ball series. He is the second-born son and youngest child of Bardock and Gine, the younger brother of Raditz, the husband of Chi-Chi, and the father of Gohan and Goten. Originally sent to Earth by his parents as an infant, Kakarot was adopted by Grandpa Gohan and renamed Son Goku. A head injury at an early age altered Goku's memory, ridding him of his initial destructive nature and allowing him to grow up to become one of Earth's greatest defenders. Goku constantly strives and trains to be the greatest warrior that he can possibly be, which has kept the Earth and the universe safe from destruction multiple times.

personnages.description: Monkey D. Luffy, commonly known as "Straw Hat Luffy" or simply "Straw Hat", is the founder and captain of the Straw Hat Pirates. He pursues the legendary treasure of the late Gol D. Roger in order to become the new Pirate King and reach a further, untold dream (currently known to only his crew, family and closest friends). He believes that being the Pirate King means having the most freedom in the world. Born on Dawn Island, Luffy is the son of Revolutionary leader Monkey D. Dragon and grandson of the Marine hero Monkey D. Garp and as such is a member of the Clan of D. Most of his childhood was shaped by Garp and Curly Dadan, under whose care he befriended and swore brotherhood to the late Portgas D. Ace and Sabo. However, he draws his greatest inspiration from the pirate Shanks, who (unwittingly) enabled him to eat the Devil Fruit that turned his body into rubber, sacrificed an arm to save his life, and gifted his signature straw hat as a symbol of their vow to reunite someday, after Luffy became a great pirate. As a pirate, Luffy has actively opposed countless regional, national, and global powers, beginning with several established East Blue pirates and extending to the Marines, the Seven Warlords of the Sea, Cipher Pol, the World Nobles and Five Elders, and even the Four Emperors of the New World. Despite his young age and relatively short career, he has triumphed over a majority of these, successfully invading and indirectly causing the annihilation of Enies Lobby, escap
